title.zh: 卷四十七 本紀第四十七 瀛國公 益王 衞王
title.en: Volume 47 Annals 47: Ying Guogong, Yiwang, Weiwang
title.raw: 卷四十七 本紀第四十七 瀛國公 益王 衞王 Volume 47 Annals 47: Ying Guogong, Yiwang, Weiwang

sentences.zh: 瀛國公

translations.literal: Duke of Ying
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Ying

sentences.zh: 瀛國公名㬎，度宗皇帝子也，母曰全皇后，咸淳七年九月己丑，生於臨安府之大內。

translations.literal: The Duke of Ying, personal name Xian, was a son of Emperor Duzong; his mother was Empress Quan. On the day jichou of the ninth month of the seventh year of Xianchun he was born in the Great Inner Palace of Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Ying, whose personal name was Xian, was a son of Emperor Duzong. His mother was Empress Quan. On the jichou day of the ninth month in the seventh year of Xianchun, he was born in the imperial palace at Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 九年十一月授左衛上將軍，封嘉國公。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the ninth year he was appointed General-in-Chief of the Left Guard and enfeoffed as Duke of Jia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the ninth year he was made General-in-Chief of the Left Guard and enfeoffed as Duke of Jia.

sentences.zh: 十年七月癸未，度宗崩，奉遺詔即皇帝位於柩前，年四歲，謝太后臨朝稱詔。

translations.literal: On guiwei of the seventh month of the tenth year Emperor Duzong died. Following the testamentary edict, [the child] took the imperial throne before the coffin at age four; Empress Dowager Xie held court and issued edicts in his name.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the seventh month of the tenth year, Emperor Duzong died. In accordance with his final edict, the boy took the throne before the coffin at the age of four, while Empress Dowager Xie held court and spoke in his name.

sentences.zh: 甲申，兄昰保康軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封吉王，加食邑一千戶；

translations.literal: On jiashen, his elder brother Xian was Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army and Grand Preceptor with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies; he was advanced to Prince of Ji and granted an additional thousand households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, his elder brother Xian, already Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army and a Grand Preceptor with privileges equal to the Three Excellencies, was promoted to Prince of Ji and given an additional thousand households in his fief.

sentences.zh: 弟昺保寧軍節度使、開府儀同三司，進封信王，加食邑一千戶。

translations.literal: His younger brother Bing was Military Commissioner of the Baoning Army and Grand Preceptor with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies; he was advanced to Prince of Xin and granted an additional thousand households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Bing, Military Commissioner of the Baoning Army and likewise a Grand Preceptor with privileges equal to the Three Excellencies, was promoted to Prince of Xin and given an additional thousand households in his fief.

sentences.zh: 命平章賈似道依文彥博故事，獨班起居。

translations.literal: [The court] ordered Grand Councillor Jia Sidao, following the precedent of Wen Yanbo, to stand alone in his rank during court audiences.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councillor Jia Sidao was ordered, following the precedent set by Wen Yanbo, to take his place alone in the audience formation.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上皇太后尊號曰壽和聖福太皇太后，皇后曰皇太后。

translations.literal: On bingxu, [the court] elevated the honorific title of the Grand Empress Dowager to Grand Empress Dowager Shouhe Shengfu, and the empress to Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the court bestowed on the Grand Empress Dowager the elevated title Grand Empress Dowager Shouhe Shengfu, and on the empress the title Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 又詔以生日爲天瑞節。

translations.literal: An edict also designated his birthday as the Tianrui Festival.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also declared his birthday the Tianrui Festival.

sentences.zh: 戊子，命臨安府振贍細民。

translations.literal: On wuzi, [the court] ordered Lin'an Prefecture to provide relief and sustenance for the common people.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to provide relief for the common people.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以朱禩孫爲京湖、四川宣撫使兼知江陵府。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Zhu Misun was appointed Commissioner for Pacification of the Capital Region, Huguang, and Sichuan, with concurrent appointment as prefect of Jiangling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Zhu Misun was made Commissioner for Pacification of the Capital Region, Huguang, and Sichuan, and concurrently prefect of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔撫三邊將士。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict ordered that the officers and soldiers of the three frontiers be comforted.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, an edict was issued to comfort the troops on all three frontiers.

sentences.zh: 命州郡舉遺逸。

translations.literal: [The court] ordered the prefectures and commanderies to recommend recluses of outstanding talent.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the prefectures and commanderies to recommend reclusive men of talent.

sentences.zh: 除浙西安撫司、兩浙轉運司、臨安府見追贓賞錢。

translations.literal: [The court] remitted the currently pursued illicit-gains reward money owed by the Zhexi Pacification Commission, the Liang-Zhe Transport Commission, and Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Outstanding illicit-gains reward payments owed by the Zhexi Pacification Commission, the Liang-Zhe Transport Commission, and Lin'an Prefecture were remitted.

sentences.zh: 詔求言。

translations.literal: An edict solicited remonstrance and counsel.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for memorials offering counsel.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，詔乞言于老臣江萬里、葉夢鼎、馬廷鸞、留夢炎、趙順孫、王爚。

translations.literal: On jiachen of the eighth month, an edict requested counsel from the senior ministers Jiang Wanli, Ye Mengding, Ma Tingluan, Liu Mengyan, Zhao Shunsun, and Wang Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the eighth month, an edict asked the senior statesmen Jiang Wanli, Ye Mengding, Ma Tingluan, Liu Mengyan, Zhao Shunsun, and Wang Ye for their advice.

sentences.zh: 李庭芝築清河城，以圖來上，詔庭芝進一秩，宣勞將士，具名推賞。

translations.literal: Li Tingzhi built Qinghe Fortress and submitted a map of it; an edict advanced Tingzhi one rank, proclaimed rewards for the officers and soldiers, and ordered that names be submitted for individual commendation.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi built Qinghe Fortress and presented a map of the work to the throne. The court advanced him one rank, proclaimed rewards for his troops, and ordered that individual names be submitted for commendation.

sentences.zh: 加知鄂州李雷應守軍器監，知太平州孟之縉尚書兵部員外郎，知江州錢真孫直寶章閣，知鎮江軍洪起畏直敷文閣。

translations.literal: Li Leiying, prefect of Ezhou, was additionally appointed Director of the Directorate of Armaments; Meng Zhijin, prefect of Taiping Prefecture, was made Vice Director of the Ministry of War; Qian Zhensun, prefect of Jiangzhou, was granted direct appointment to the Baozhang Pavilion; Hong Qiwei, prefect of the Zhenjiang Army, was granted direct appointment to the Fuwen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Li Leiying, prefect of Ezhou, was additionally made Director of the Directorate of Armaments; Meng Zhijin of Taiping Prefecture was appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of War; Qian Zhensun of Jiangzhou received direct appointment to the Baozhang Pavilion; and Hong Qiwei of the Zhenjiang Army received direct appointment to the Fuwen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大霖雨，天目山崩，水湧流，安吉、臨安、余杭民溺死者亡算。

translations.literal: On guichou, torrential rain fell; Mount Tianmu collapsed and water surged forth; in Anji, Lin'an, and Yuhang the drowned among the people were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, heavy rains fell, Mount Tianmu collapsed, and floodwaters poured out. In Anji, Lin'an, and Yuhang, countless people drowned.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太皇太后以老不能御正衙，命暫以慈元殿爲後殿。

translations.literal: On jiayin, because the Grand Empress Dowager was aged and could not preside in the main audience hall, [the court] ordered that the Ciyuan Hall temporarily serve as the rear audience hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, because the Grand Empress Dowager was too old to hold court in the main hall, the Ciyuan Hall was temporarily designated the rear audience hall.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，作度宗廟。

translations.literal: On xinyou, [the court] constructed the temple of Emperor Duzong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, work began on the temple of Emperor Duzong.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以全清夫爲昭信軍節度使，謝堂檢校少保，謝垕保康軍節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Quan Qingfu was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army; Xie Tang was made Junior Guardian with acting status; Xie Hou was made Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Quan Qingfu was made Military Commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army, Xie Tang Acting Junior Guardian, and Xie Hou Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army.

sentences.zh: 馬廷鸞乞骸骨歸田里，詔趣之任。

translations.literal: Ma Tingluan requested his bones and return to his home village; an edict urged him to take up his post.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Tingluan asked to retire to his home district, but an edict pressed him to return to office.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，資政殿大學士、光祿大夫王爚乞致仕，詔不允。

translations.literal: On dingchou of the ninth month, Wang Ye, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, requested retirement; an edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the ninth month, Wang Ye, Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, asked to retire, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，發米振余杭、臨安兩縣水災。

translations.literal: On wuyin, grain was distributed to relieve the flood disaster in the two counties of Yuhang and Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, grain was issued to relieve the flood victims of Yuhang and Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 余杭災甚，再給米二千石。

translations.literal: Yuhang's disaster was severe, and an additional two thousand piculs of grain were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yuhang had suffered especially heavily, another two thousand piculs of grain were allotted.

sentences.zh: 己卯，似道乞免答拜，從之。

translations.literal: On jimao, Sidao requested exemption from the bow of acknowledgment in audience; [the court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Jia Sidao asked to be excused from the acknowledgment bow in audience, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，覆試文武舉士人。

translations.literal: On xinsi, civil and military examination candidates were re-examined.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, civil and military examination candidates underwent re-examination.

sentences.zh: 壬午，覆試文武舉士人。

translations.literal: On renwu, civil and military examination candidates were re-examined.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, civil and military examination candidates were again re-examined.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大元兵大會於襄陽。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Great Yuan forces assembled in great numbers at Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Yuan armies gathered in force at Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，丞相伯顏將一軍趣郢州，元帥唆都將一軍入淮，翟招討將一軍徇荊南。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Chancellor Bayan led one army toward Yingzhou; Marshal Suodu led one army into the Huai region; and Recruitment Commissioner Zhai led one army to overrun Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Chancellor Bayan led one army toward Yingzhou, Marshal Suodu another into the Huai region, and Recruitment Commissioner Zhai a third to overrun Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大元軍薄郢州。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Great Yuan army pressed close to Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Yuan army drew up before Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，免被水州縣今年田租。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the land tax of this year was remitted for the prefectures and counties afflicted by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, this year's land tax was remitted for all flood-stricken prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 甲午，初開經筵。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Classics Lecture was opened for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the emperor's Classics Lecture was inaugurated.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，天瑞節，免徵臨安府公私房賃錢十日。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Tianrui Festival, the rent money on public and private houses in Lin'an Prefecture was exempted for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the Tianrui Festival, house rents in Lin'an were waived for ten days.

sentences.zh: 以金符十三、銀符百給夏貴激賞奇功。

translations.literal: Thirteen gold tally-plaques and one hundred silver tally-plaques were given to Xia Gui to stimulate reward for extraordinary merit.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen gold tally-plaques and one hundred silver tally-plaques were given to Xia Gui to reward extraordinary service.

sentences.zh: 己亥，試正奏名進士，賜王龍澤以下出身有差。

translations.literal: On jihai, the regular memorial-presented jinshi were examined; Wang Longze and those below him were granted official status in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the regular memorial-presented jinshi were examined, and Wang Longze and the others were granted official status in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，有星見西方，委曲如蚓。

translations.literal: On renyin, a star appeared in the west, winding like an earthworm.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, a comet appeared in the west, winding across the sky like an earthworm.

sentences.zh: 復州副將翟國榮遇大元兵，戰爛泥湖，死之。

translations.literal: Zhai Guorong, vice commander of Fuzhou, encountered Great Yuan troops, fought at Lanni Lake, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Guorong, vice commander of Fuzhou, met Yuan forces at Lanni Lake, fought, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 閩中旱。

translations.literal: Fujian suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian was stricken by drought.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，知達州趙章復洋州，加右驍騎尉中郎將。

translations.literal: On bingwu of the tenth month of winter, Zhao Zhang, prefect of Dazhou, recovered Yangzhou and was advanced to Commandant of Cavalry of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the tenth month of winter, Zhao Zhang, prefect of Dazhou, recovered Yangzhou and was promoted to Commandant of Cavalry of the Right.

sentences.zh: 大元兵破渠州禮義城，知州張資自殺。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops captured Liyi Fortress of Qizhou; Prefect Zhang Zi killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces took Liyi Fortress in Qizhou, and Prefect Zhang Zi committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 丁未，饒州布衣董聲應進《諸史纂約》、《兵鑒》、《刑鑒》，詔聲應充史館編校文字。

translations.literal: On dingwei, the commoner of Raozhou Dong Shengying presented the Compendium of Various Histories, the Mirror of Warfare, and the Mirror of Punishments; an edict appointed Shengying Compiler and Textual Reviser at the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Dong Shengying, a commoner of Raozhou, presented his Compendium of Various Histories, Mirror of Warfare, and Mirror of Punishments. The court appointed him compiler and textual reviser at the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上度宗諡。

translations.literal: On guichou, Emperor Duzong's posthumous title was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the posthumous title of Emperor Duzong was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 廣西經略司權參議官邢友龍擊潮州、漳州寇，破之。

translations.literal: Xing Youlong, acting deliberator of the Guangxi Pacification Commission, attacked the bandits of Chaozhou and Zhangzhou and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Youlong, acting deliberator on the Guangxi Pacification Commission, attacked the rebels in Chaozhou and Zhangzhou and routed them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，令州縣行義田、義役。

translations.literal: On yimao, [the court] ordered the prefectures and counties to implement charitable fields and charitable corvée service.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the prefectures and counties were ordered to establish charitable fields and charitable corvée service.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，友龍以下諸將各轉官有差。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Youlong and the generals below him were each advanced in rank to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Youlong and the other commanders were each promoted in rank according to merit.

sentences.zh: 大元兵攻郢州，都統制張世傑力戰御之，遂去，由藤湖入漢。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops attacked Yingzhou; Commander-in-Chief Zhang Shijie fought fiercely to repel them, whereupon [the enemy] withdrew and entered the Han River by way of Teng Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces attacked Yingzhou, but Commander-in-Chief Zhang Shijie fought them off. They then withdrew and entered the Han River through Teng Lake.

sentences.zh: 戊午，郢州副都統趙文義追戰全子湖死，恤其家。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Zhao Wenyi, vice commander-in-chief of Yingzhou, pursued the enemy in battle at Quanzi Lake and died; his family was granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zhao Wenyi, vice commander-in-chief of Yingzhou, pursued the enemy to Quanzi Lake, was killed in battle, and his family received relief.

sentences.zh: 庚申，贈翟國榮復州團練使，官其二子，立廟復州。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Zhai Guorong was posthumously enfeoffed as Military Training Commissioner of Fuzhou; his two sons were given office, and a temple was established for him in Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Zhai Guorong was posthumously made Military Training Commissioner of Fuzhou, his two sons were given official posts, and a temple was erected in his honor at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以錢百萬給郢城屯戍將士。

translations.literal: On renxu, one million in cash was granted to the garrison troops stationed at Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, one million in cash was allotted to the garrison at Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔以明年爲德祐元年。

translations.literal: On jiazi, an edict declared that the coming year would be the first year of Deyou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, an edict proclaimed the coming year the first year of Deyou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以章鑒同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，陳宜中簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On yichou, Zhang Jian was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs with acting concurrent status as Vice Grand Councillor; Chen Yizhong was appointed Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs with acting concurrent status as Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Zhang Jian was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs with acting status as Vice Grand Councillor, and Chen Yizhong Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs with the same acting rank.

sentences.zh: 大元兵徇沙洋城，京湖宣撫司遣總管王虎臣援之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops overran Shayang Fortress; the Huguang Pacification Commission dispatched Commander Wang Huchen to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces overran Shayang Fortress, and the Huguang Pacification Commission sent Commander Wang Huchen to its relief.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，城破，虎臣與守隘官王大用皆被執。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the fortress fell; Huchen and the pass-defending officer Wang Dayong were both captured.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the fortress fell, and both Wang Huchen and the pass officer Wang Dayong were taken prisoner.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯鎮星。

translations.literal: The Sparkling Deluder encroached upon the Queller Star.
translations.idiomatic: Mars encroached upon Saturn.

sentences.zh: 大元兵至新城。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops reached Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces reached Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，總制黃順出降。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Commander Huang Shun came out and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Commander Huang Shun surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己巳，副總制仁寧出降。

translations.literal: On jisi, Vice Commander Ren Ning came out and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Vice Commander Ren Ning surrendered.

sentences.zh: 都統制邊居誼力戰，城破，赴火死。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Bian Juyi fought fiercely; when the city fell he threw himself into the fire and died.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Bian Juyi fought to the end; when the city fell he threw himself into the flames and died.

sentences.zh: 知復州翟貴以城降。

translations.literal: Zhai Gui, prefect of Fuzhou, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Gui, prefect of Fuzhou, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 閩中地震。

translations.literal: Fujian was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: An earthquake struck Fujian.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，以朱禩孫爲京湖、四川宣撫使。

translations.literal: On guiyou of the eleventh month, Zhu Misun was appointed Commissioner for Pacification of the Capital Region, Huguang, and Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the eleventh month, Zhu Misun was appointed Commissioner for Pacification of the Capital Region, Huguang, and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命沿江制置使趙溍巡江策應，賜錢百萬激賞戰功。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Coastal Pacification Commissioner Zhao Yin was ordered to patrol the river and coordinate responses; one million in cash was granted to stimulate reward for military achievement.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Coastal Pacification Commissioner Zhao Yin was ordered to patrol the Yangzi and coordinate defenses, and one million in cash was granted to reward military merit.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，馬廷鸞力辭浙東安撫使、知紹興府，詔依舊觀文殿大學士、提舉洞霄宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Ma Tingluan firmly declined the posts of Pacification Commissioner of Eastern Zhe and Prefect of Shaoxing; an edict restored him to his former status as Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and Supervisor of the Dongxiao Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Ma Tingluan firmly declined the posts of Pacification Commissioner of Eastern Zhe and prefect of Shaoxing; the court restored him to his former rank as Academician of the Hall for Viewing Literature and supervisor of the Dongxiao Palace.

sentences.zh: 贈趙文義清遠軍節度使，與其兄威武軍節度使文亮共立廟揚州，賜名傳忠。

translations.literal: Zhao Wenyi was posthumously enfeoffed as Military Commissioner of the Qingyuan Army; together with his elder brother Wenliang, Military Commissioner of the Weiwu Army, a joint temple was established at Yangzhou and granted the name Zhuanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Wenyi was posthumously made Military Commissioner of the Qingyuan Army. A joint temple was erected for him and his elder brother Wenliang, Military Commissioner of the Weiwu Army, at Yangzhou, and named Zhuanzhong, "Transmitting Loyalty."

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以陸秀夫爲淮東安撫制置司參議官。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Lu Xiufu was appointed Deliberator of the Huaidong Pacification and Defense Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Lu Xiufu was made deliberator on the Huaidong Pacification and Defense Commission.

sentences.zh: 壬午，削諸班直溢額人。

translations.literal: On renwu, the excess personnel beyond quota in the various duty shifts were cut.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, excess personnel in the palace duty shifts were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 癸未至乙酉，覆試特奏名士人。

translations.literal: From guiwei to yiyou, specially memorial-presented examination candidates were re-examined.
translations.idiomatic: From guiwei through yiyou, specially memorial-presented candidates were re-examined.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以王爚爲左丞相，章鑑爲右丞相，並兼樞密使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Wang Ye was appointed Left Chancellor and Zhang Jian Right Chancellor, both concurrently serving as Bureau of Military Affairs Commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wang Ye was made Left Chancellor and Zhang Jian Right Chancellor, each also serving as Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 似道自九月乞命左右丞相，至是從之。

translations.literal: Since the ninth month Sidao had requested the appointment of Left and Right Chancellors; now [the court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao had asked since the ninth month that Left and Right Chancellors be appointed; at last the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 以張晏然兼京湖、四川宣撫司參議官。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanran was appointed concurrent Deliberator of the Capital Region, Huguang, and Sichuan Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanran was made concurrent deliberator on the Capital Region, Huguang, and Sichuan Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 己丑至庚寅，覆試特奏名士人。

translations.literal: From jichou to gengyin, specially memorial-presented examination candidates were re-examined.
translations.idiomatic: From jichou through gengyin, specially memorial-presented candidates were again re-examined.

sentences.zh: 壬辰至癸巳，如上覆試。

translations.literal: From renchen to guisi, re-examination proceeded as above.
translations.idiomatic: From renchen through guisi, re-examination continued as before.

sentences.zh: 甲午，括邸第戚畹及御前寺觀田，令輸租。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the fields of mansions, imperial affines, and imperially sponsored temples and monasteries were inventoried and ordered to pay rent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, lands held by mansions, imperial affines, and imperial temples were surveyed and ordered to pay rent.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，加安南國王陳日煚寧遠功臣，其子威晃奉正功臣。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the King of Annam Chen Rixuan was advanced to Meritous Subject of Pacifying the Distant; his son Weihuang was made Meritous Subject of Upholding Rectitude.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the king of Annam, Chen Rixuan, was advanced to Meritous Subject of Pacifying the Distant, and his son Weihuang to Meritous Subject of Upholding Rectitude.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，命建康府、太平州、池州振避兵淮民。

translations.literal: On the first day guimao of the twelfth month, Jiankang Prefecture, Taiping Prefecture, and Chizhou were ordered to provide relief for Huai refugees fleeing warfare.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, Jiankang, Taiping, and Chizhou were ordered to provide relief for refugees from the Huai region fleeing the war.

sentences.zh: 以隆寒，勞賜京湖及沿江戍守將士。

translations.literal: Because of severe cold, the garrison officers and soldiers of the Capital Region, Huguang, and the river line were comforted and rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the bitter cold, the garrison troops along the Huguang front and the Yangzi line were comforted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 甲胡，詔淮西四郡水旱，去年屯田未輸之租其勿徵。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict [stated that] the four prefectures of Western Huai had suffered flood and drought; the garrison-field rents not yet delivered last year were not to be collected.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, an edict declared that because the four Western Huai prefectures had suffered flood and drought, garrison-field rents still unpaid from the previous year would not be collected.

sentences.zh: 丁未，提舉興國宮呂師夔請募兵江州，詔知州錢真孫同募，尚書省以錢米給之。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Lu Shiqiao, Supervisor of the Xingguo Palace, requested to recruit troops at Jiangzhou; an edict ordered Prefect Qian Zhensun to recruit jointly; the Department of State Affairs supplied money and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Lu Shiqiao, supervisor of the Xingguo Palace, asked permission to raise troops at Jiangzhou. The court ordered Prefect Qian Zhensun to recruit jointly with him, and the Department of State Affairs supplied funds and grain.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大元兵攻陽邏堡，夏貴以兵力守，武定軍都統制王達戰死。

translations.literal: On guichou, Great Yuan troops attacked Yangluo Fortress; Xia Gui defended it with his forces; Wang Da, commander-in-chief of the Wuding Army, died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Yuan forces attacked Yangluo Fortress. Xia Gui held it with his army, but Wang Da, commander-in-chief of the Wuding Army, was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大元兵夜以偏師乘雪渡青山磯。

translations.literal: On yimao, Great Yuan troops by night used a detached column to cross Qingshan Jetty in the snow.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, under cover of night and snow, a Yuan detachment crossed Qingshan Jetty.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，都統程鵬飛鏖戰，被重創，歸鄂州，都統高邦憲屯馬家渡，棄舟走，被執。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Commander Cheng Pengfei fought a bitter engagement, suffered grave wounds, and returned to Ezhou; Commander Gao Bangxian was stationed at Majia Ford, abandoned his boats and fled, and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Commander Cheng Pengfei fought a fierce engagement, was gravely wounded, and withdrew to Ezhou. Commander Gao Bangxian, stationed at Majia Ford, abandoned his boats and fled, and was captured.

sentences.zh: 大元兵復攻夏貴于陽邏堡，都統制劉成以定海水軍戰死。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops again attacked Xia Gui at Yangluo Fortress; Commander-in-Chief Liu Cheng died in battle with the Dinghai naval force.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces again attacked Xia Gui at Yangluo Fortress, and Commander-in-Chief Liu Cheng was killed fighting with the Dinghai fleet.

sentences.zh: 貴敗，沿江縱兵大掠，歸廬州。

translations.literal: Gui was defeated; along the river he let his troops plunder on a great scale and returned to Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gui was defeated, let his troops plunder freely along the river, and retreated to Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 朱禩孫將兵至鄂州，聞鄂兵敗，夜奔江陵府。

translations.literal: Zhu Misun led troops to Ezhou; hearing that the Ezhou army had been defeated, he fled by night to Jiangling Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Misun marched to Ezhou with his troops, but on hearing of the defeat there he fled by night to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 己未，權知漢陽軍王儀以城降。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Wang Yi, acting prefect of the Hanyang Army, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Wang Yi, acting prefect of the Hanyang Army, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 呂文煥以北兵攻鄂州。

translations.literal: Lü Wenhuan attacked Ezhou with the northern troops.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wenhuan attacked Ezhou with the northern army.

sentences.zh: 庚申，程鵬飛及權守張晏然以城降。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Cheng Pengfei and Acting Defender Zhang Yanran surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Cheng Pengfei and Acting Defender Zhang Yanran surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 幕僚張山翁不屈，諸將欲殺之，丞相伯顏曰：「義士也，釋之。

translations.literal: Staff officer Zhang Shanneng would not submit; the generals wished to kill him, but Chancellor Bayan said: "He is a man of righteousness—release him."
translations.idiomatic: Staff officer Zhang Shanneng refused to submit. The generals wanted to kill him, but Chancellor Bayan said, "He is a man of honor. Release him."

sentences.zh: 」詔錢塘、仁和兩縣民年七十至九十已上者，賜帛及酒米。

translations.literal: An edict [ordered that] among the people of the two counties of Qiantang and Renhe, those aged seventy to over ninety were to be granted silk, wine, and grain.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted silk, wine, and grain to residents of Qiantang and Renhe aged seventy and above.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔似道都督諸路軍馬，以步軍指揮使孫虎臣總統諸軍，所辟官屬皆先命後奏。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict appointed Sidao Commander-in-Chief of the military forces of all circuits; Infantry Commander Sun Huchen was made overall commander of all armies; all officials he recruited were to be appointed first and memorialized afterward.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, an edict made Jia Sidao commander-in-chief of all armies. Infantry Commander Sun Huchen was placed in overall command, and all officials Sidao recruited were to be appointed first and reported afterward.

sentences.zh: 詔天下勤王。

translations.literal: An edict called the realm to muster in defense of the throne.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called on the realm to rally to the throne's defense.

sentences.zh: 甲子，起李芾爲湖南提刑。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Li Fei was recalled to serve as Judicial Commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Li Fei was recalled as Judicial Commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以高達爲湖北制置使兼安撫、知江陵府。

translations.literal: On yichou, Gao Da was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Hubei with concurrent posts as Pacification Commissioner and Prefect of Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Gao Da was made Pacification Commissioner of Hubei, with concurrent duties as pacification commissioner and prefect of Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 詔：「邊費浩繁，吾民重困，貴戚釋道，田連阡陌，安居暇食，有司核其租稅收之。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Frontier expenses are vast and our people are sorely afflicted. Nobles and Buddhist clergy hold fields stretching from lane to lane, dwelling in ease and eating at leisure—let the authorities verify their rents and taxes and collect them."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared: "Frontier costs are enormous and our people are sorely burdened. Nobles and clergy hold fields stretching lane upon lane, living at ease while others starve. Let the authorities verify their rents and taxes and collect them."

sentences.zh: 」贈王達清遠軍承宣使。

translations.literal: Wang Da was posthumously enfeoffed as Commissioner-in-Chief of the Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Da was posthumously made Commissioner-in-Chief of the Qingyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 庚午，度宗梓宮發引至浙江上，俟潮漲絕江，潮失期，日晡不至。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the coffin of Emperor Duzong was escorted forth to the banks of the Zhe River, awaiting the rising tide to cross the river; the tide failed to arrive on schedule, and by late afternoon it had not come.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Emperor Duzong's coffin was escorted to the Zhe River to await the flood tide for the crossing, but the tide failed to come, and by late afternoon it had still not risen.

sentences.zh: 程鵬飛以北兵徇黃州，知州陳奕遣人請降于壽昌軍。

translations.literal: Cheng Pengfei with the northern troops overran Huangzhou; Prefect Chen Yi sent a messenger to request surrender at the Shouchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Pengfei overran Huangzhou with the northern army, and Prefect Chen Yi sent envoys to offer surrender at Shouchang.

sentences.zh: 李庭芝以兵勤王。

translations.literal: Li Tingzhi led troops to muster in defense of the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Li Tingzhi marched his troops to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命州郡節制駐戍經從兵。

translations.literal: On xinwei, [the court] ordered the prefectures and commanderies to regulate the garrison troops stationed along the imperial progress route.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the prefectures and commanderies were ordered to regulate troops garrisoned along the imperial route.

sentences.zh: 德祐元年春正月癸酉朔，大元兵入黃州。

translations.literal: On the first day guiyou of the first month of spring in the first year of Deyou, Great Yuan troops entered Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Deyou, Yuan forces entered Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，陳奕遣人下蘄州，並招其子岩于安東州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Chen Yi sent men down to Qizhou and also summoned his son Yan at Andong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Chen Yi sent envoys down to Qizhou and summoned his son Yan at Andong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，知蘄州管景模遣人請降于黃州。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Guan Jingmo, prefect of Qizhou, sent a messenger to request surrender at Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Guan Jingmo, prefect of Qizhou, sent envoys to offer surrender at Huangzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔浙東邸第出米，減價糶民。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict ordered the mansions of Eastern Zhe to release grain and sell it to the people at reduced price.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, an edict ordered the mansions of Eastern Zhe to release grain and sell it to the people at reduced prices.

sentences.zh: 壬午，葬度宗於永紹陵。

translations.literal: On renwu, Emperor Duzong was buried at Yongshao Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Emperor Duzong was interred at Yongshao Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 大元兵入蘄州。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops entered Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces entered Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，似道以呂師夔權刑部尚書、都督府參贊軍事，任中流調遣。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Sidao appointed Lü Shiqiao Acting Director of the Ministry of Justice and Staff Officer for Military Affairs at the Commandery Headquarters, with authority to coordinate mid-river deployments.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Jia Sidao made Lü Shiqiao Acting Director of the Ministry of Justice and staff officer at the command headquarters, with authority to coordinate deployments along the mid-Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以陳宜中同知樞密院事兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Chen Yizhong was appointed Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs with concurrent status as Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Chen Yizhong was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 呂師夔、錢真孫遣人請降於蘄州。

translations.literal: Lü Shiqiao and Qian Zhensun sent messengers to request surrender at Qizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Shiqiao and Qian Zhensun sent envoys to offer surrender at Qizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大元兵徇江州。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Great Yuan troops overran Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yuan forces overran Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 知安東州陳岩夜遁。

translations.literal: Chen Yan, prefect of Andong Prefecture, fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yan, prefect of Andong, fled under cover of night.

sentences.zh: 邳州降。

translations.literal: Pizhou surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Pizhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 知壽昌軍胡夢麟寓治于江州，丁亥，自殺。

translations.literal: Hu Menglin, prefect of the Shouchang Army, was administering from Jiangzhou; on dinghai he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Menglin, prefect of the Shouchang Army, was administering from Jiangzhou; on dinghai he committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 戊子，知南康軍葉閶遣人請降于江州。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Ye Chang, prefect of the Nankang Army, sent a messenger to request surrender at Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Ye Chang, prefect of the Nankang Army, sent envoys to offer surrender at Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 似道出師。

translations.literal: Sidao took the field.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao took command in the field.

sentences.zh: 知德安府來興國以城降。

translations.literal: Lai Xingguo, prefect of De'an Prefecture, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Lai Xingguo, prefect of De'an, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 夔路安撫張起岩與其將弋德攻開州，復取之。

translations.literal: Zhang Qiyan, pacification commissioner of the Kuizhou circuit, and his general Yi De attacked Kaizhou and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qiyan, pacification commissioner of the Kuizhou circuit, and his general Yi De attacked Kaizhou and recovered it.

sentences.zh: 己丑，知安慶府範文虎遣人以酒饌如江州迎師。

translations.literal: On jichou, Fan Wenhu, prefect of Anqing Prefecture, sent men with wine and food to Jiangzhou to welcome the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Fan Wenhu, prefect of Anqing, sent men with wine and provisions to Jiangzhou to welcome the Yuan army.

sentences.zh: 乙未，附度宗神主于新宮。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the spirit tablet of Emperor Duzong was installed in the new palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Emperor Duzong's spirit tablet was installed in the new palace.

sentences.zh: 以孫虎臣爲寧武軍節度使。

translations.literal: Sun Huchen was appointed Military Commissioner of the Ningwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Huchen was made Military Commissioner of the Ningwu Army.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，赦京畿罪。

translations.literal: On wuxu, crimes in the capital region were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, crimes in the capital region were amnestied.

sentences.zh: 池州都統張林遣人請降于江州。

translations.literal: Zhang Lin, commander of Chizhou, sent a messenger to request surrender at Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Lin, commander of Chizhou, sent envoys to offer surrender at Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 大元兵入安慶，範文虎降，通判夏椅仰藥死。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops entered Anqing; Fan Wenhu surrendered; Vice Prefect Xia Yi took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces entered Anqing. Fan Wenhu surrendered, while Vice Prefect Xia Yi took poison and died.

sentences.zh: 是月，知達州鮮汝忠以城降。

translations.literal: That month, Xian Ruzhong, prefect of Dazhou, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Xian Ruzhong, prefect of Dazhou, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，似道以宋京爲都督府計議官，使大元軍中。

translations.literal: On guimao of the second month, Sidao appointed Song Jing Planning Officer at the Commandery Headquarters and sent him to the Great Yuan army.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the second month, Jia Sidao appointed Song Jing planning officer at the command headquarters and sent him to the Yuan camp.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以黃萬石爲江南西路制置使，加湖北制置副使高達檢校少保。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Huang Wanshi was appointed Pacification Commissioner of Jiangnan West Circuit; Gao Da, Vice Pacification Commissioner of Hubei, was advanced to Acting Junior Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Huang Wanshi was made Pacification Commissioner of Jiangnan West Circuit, and Gao Da, Vice Pacification Commissioner of Hubei, was promoted to Acting Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大元兵入池州，權守趙卯發自經死。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Great Yuan troops entered Chizhou; Acting Defender Zhao Maofa hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Yuan forces entered Chizhou, and Acting Defender Zhao Maofa hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 宋京如軍中，請稱臣、奉歲幣，不得請而還。

translations.literal: Song Jing went to the army camp and requested to declare vassalage and pay annual tribute; the request was not granted and he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jing went to the Yuan camp and asked that Song declare itself a vassal and pay annual tribute. The request was refused, and he returned.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，贈劉成清遠軍承宣使。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Liu Cheng was posthumously enfeoffed as Commissioner-in-Chief of the Qingyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Liu Cheng was posthumously made Commissioner-in-Chief of the Qingyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，五郡鎮撫呂文福遣所部淮兵入衛，降詔褒之。

translations.literal: On yimao, Lü Wenfu, pacification commissioner of the five prefectures, dispatched his Huai troops to the capital for defense; an edict was issued commending him.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Lü Wenfu, pacification commissioner of five prefectures, sent his Huai troops to defend the capital, and an edict commended him.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔勞賈似道，命都督府歲舉改官如史嵩之故事。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict comforted Jia Sidao and ordered the Commandery Headquarters each year to recommend promotions following the precedent of Shi Songzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, an edict praised Jia Sidao and ordered the command headquarters to recommend annual promotions following the precedent of Shi Songzhi.

sentences.zh: 己未，加張起岩福州觀察使，弋德以下各轉五官。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Zhang Qiyan was advanced to Regional Inspector of Fuzhou; Yi De and those below were each advanced five ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhang Qiyan was promoted to Regional Inspector of Fuzhou, and Yi De and his subordinates were each advanced five ranks.

sentences.zh: 庚申，虎臣與大元兵戰于丁家洲，敗績，奔魯港，夏貴不戰而去。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Huchen fought Great Yuan troops at Dingjia Sandbar, suffered defeat, and fled to Lugang; Xia Gui departed without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Sun Huchen fought the Yuan at Dingjia Sandbar, was routed, and fled to Lugang, while Xia Gui withdrew without engaging.

sentences.zh: 似道、虎臣以單舸奔揚州，諸軍盡潰，翁應龍以都督府印奔臨安。

translations.literal: Sidao and Huchen fled in a single boat to Yangzhou; all armies were utterly routed; Weng Yinglong fled to Lin'an with the Commandery Headquarters seal.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao and Sun Huchen fled alone in a single boat to Yangzhou. The armies collapsed completely, and Weng Yinglong fled to Lin'an with the command headquarters seal.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大元兵徇饒州，知州唐震死之。

translations.literal: On renxu, Great Yuan troops overran Raozhou; Prefect Tang Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yuan forces overran Raozhou, and Prefect Tang Zhen was killed.

sentences.zh: 故相江萬里赴水死，通判萬道同以城降。

translations.literal: Former Chancellor Jiang Wanli threw himself into the water and died; Vice Prefect Wan Datong surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Former Chancellor Jiang Wanli drowned himself, and Vice Prefect Wan Datong surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 沿江制置大使趙溍、知鎮江府洪起畏、知寧國府趙與可、知隆興府吳益皆棄城遁。

translations.literal: Coastal Pacification Commissioner Zhao Yin, Hong Qiwei prefect of Zhenjiang, Zhao Yuke prefect of Ningguo, and Wu Yi prefect of Longxing all abandoned their cities and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Coastal Pacification Commissioner Zhao Yin, Hong Qiwei of Zhenjiang, Zhao Yuke of Ningguo, and Wu Yi of Longxing all abandoned their cities and fled.

sentences.zh: 知和州王喜以城降。

translations.literal: Wang Xi, prefect of Hezhou, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xi, prefect of Hezhou, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 建康都統翁福出迎大元兵。

translations.literal: Weng Fu, commander of Jiankang, went out to welcome the Great Yuan army.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Fu, commander of Jiankang, went out to welcome the Yuan army.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大元兵至臨江軍，民盡去，知軍鮑廉死之。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Great Yuan troops reached the Linjiang Army; the people all fled; Commander Bao Lian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Yuan forces reached the Linjiang Army. The populace fled, and Commander Bao Lian was killed.

sentences.zh: 似道上書請遷都。

translations.literal: Sidao submitted a memorial requesting transfer of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao memorialized the throne requesting that the capital be moved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，下公卿雜議，王爚言己不能與大計，遂去。

translations.literal: On yichou, the matter was referred for discussion among the ministers; Wang Ye said he could not participate in great policy and then departed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the court ordered open discussion among the ministers. Wang Ye said he could not take part in major policy and resigned.

sentences.zh: 張世傑將兵入衛臨安，道饒州，復取之，其將謝元、王海、李旺、袁恩、呂再興皆戰死。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie led troops to defend Lin'an; passing through Raozhou he recovered it; his generals Xie Yuan, Wang Hai, Li Wang, Yuan En, and Lü Zaixing all died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie marched to defend Lin'an, retook Raozhou on the way, and lost his generals Xie Yuan, Wang Hai, Li Wang, Yuan En, and Lü Zaixing in battle.

sentences.zh: 江西提刑文天祥起兵勤王。

translations.literal: Wen Tianxiang, Judicial Commissioner of Jiangxi, raised troops to muster in defense of the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Tianxiang, Judicial Commissioner of Jiangxi, raised an army to rally to the throne's defense.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以天祥爲江西安撫副使、知贛州，趣入衛。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Tianxiang was appointed Vice Pacification Commissioner of Jiangxi and Prefect of Ganzhou, and urged to enter the capital for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wen Tianxiang was made Vice Pacification Commissioner of Jiangxi and prefect of Ganzhou, and ordered to hurry to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 詔募兵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered recruitment of troops.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered general recruitment of troops.

sentences.zh: 以謝堂爲兩浙鎮撫使，謝至保寧軍節度使，全永堅、謝垕並檢校少保。

translations.literal: Xie Tang was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Two Zhes; Xie Zhi was made Military Commissioner of the Baoning Army; Quan Yongjian and Xie Hou were both made Acting Junior Guardians.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Tang was made Pacification Commissioner of the Two Zhes, Xie Zhi Military Commissioner of the Baoning Army, and Quan Yongjian and Xie Hou both Acting Junior Guardians.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，徵兩浙、福建諸郡廂禁兵之半入衛。

translations.literal: On wuchen, half of the metropolitan garrison troops of the various prefectures of the Two Zhes and Fujian were summoned to the capital for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, half the metropolitan garrison troops of the Two Zhes and Fujian were summoned to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 湖南提刑李芾以兵勤王。

translations.literal: Li Fei, Judicial Commissioner of Hunan, led troops to muster in defense of the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fei, Judicial Commissioner of Hunan, marched his troops to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 知江陰軍鄭棄城遁，知無爲軍劉權、知太平州孟之縉皆以城降。

translations.literal: Zheng, prefect of the Jiangyin Army, abandoned the city and fled; Liu Quan, prefect of the Wuwei Army, and Meng Zhijin, prefect of Taiping Prefecture, all surrendered their cities.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect of the Jiangyin Army fled, abandoning his city; Liu Quan of the Wuwei Army and Meng Zhijin of Taiping both surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大元兵攻嘉定九頂山，都統侯興戰死。

translations.literal: On jisi, Great Yuan troops attacked Jiuding Mountain in Jiading; Commander Hou Xing died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Yuan forces attacked Jiuding Mountain in Jiading, and Commander Hou Xing was killed.

sentences.zh: 以陳宜中知樞密院事兼參知政事，曾淵子同知樞密院事、兩浙安撫制置大使兼知臨安府，文及翁簽書樞密院事，倪普同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Chen Yizhong was appointed Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs with concurrent status as Vice Grand Councillor; Zeng Yuanzi was made Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Grand Pacification Commissioner of the Two Zhes with concurrent status as Prefect of Lin'an; Wen Jiweng was made Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Ni Pu was made concurrent Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yizhong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Vice Grand Councillor; Zeng Yuanzi Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Grand Pacification Commissioner of the Two Zhes, concurrently prefect of Lin'an; Wen Jiweng Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs; and Ni Pu concurrent Secretary.

sentences.zh: 召王爚爲浙西、江東宣撫招撫大使，使居京師，以備咨訪。

translations.literal: Wang Ye was summoned as Grand Pacification and Recruitment Commissioner of Western Zhe and Eastern Jiang, to reside in the capital for consultation.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ye was recalled as Grand Pacification and Recruitment Commissioner of Western Zhe and Eastern Jiang and ordered to remain in the capital for consultation.

sentences.zh: 遣大元國信使郝經等歸。

translations.literal: [The court] sent the Great Yuan credentialed envoy Hao Jing and others home.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan credentialed envoy Hao Jing and his party were sent home.

sentences.zh: 庚午，加夏貴開府儀同三司，令以所部兵入衛。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Xia Gui was advanced to Grand Preceptor with privilege equal to the Three Excellencies and ordered to lead his troops to the capital for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Xia Gui was promoted to Grand Preceptor with privileges equal to the Three Excellencies and ordered to bring his troops to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 令長吏給經過兵民錢米，一切勿徵稅。

translations.literal: [The court] ordered senior officials to supply money and grain to passing troops and civilians and to levy no taxes whatsoever.
translations.idiomatic: Senior officials were ordered to supply money and grain to passing troops and civilians and to levy no taxes of any kind.

sentences.zh: 應編配、拘鎖人，除偽造關會、強劫盜放火者，餘悉縱之。

translations.literal: Those subject to banishment assignment or detention, except forgers of transit passes, armed robbers, and arsonists, were all released.
translations.idiomatic: All those under banishment or detention were released, except forgers of transit passes, armed robbers, and arsonists.

sentences.zh: 放免浙西公田逋米及諸文武官在謫籍者，並放自便與敘復改正，放參親民。

translations.literal: Arrears of public-field grain in Western Zhe were remitted, and all civil and military officials on the demotion register were released at liberty with restoration and correction of records, and permitted to attend court as private citizens.
translations.idiomatic: Arrears on public fields in Western Zhe were remitted, demoted officials were restored and permitted to go freely, and they were allowed to attend court as private citizens.

sentences.zh: 加張珏寧遠軍節度使，昝萬壽保康軍節度使，張世傑和州防禦使，令將兵入衛。

translations.literal: Zhang Jue was advanced to Military Commissioner of the Ningyuan Army; Zan Wanshou to Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army; Zhang Shijie to Defender of Hezhou; all were ordered to lead troops to the capital for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jue was promoted to Military Commissioner of the Ningyuan Army, Zan Wanshou to Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army, and Zhang Shijie to Defender of Hezhou, each ordered to march to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 陳宜中乞誅似道，詔罷似道平章、都督，予祠。

translations.literal: Chen Yizhong requested execution of Sidao; an edict removed Sidao from his posts as Grand Councillor and Commander-in-Chief and granted him a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yizhong asked that Jia Sidao be executed. Instead, an edict stripped him of his posts as Grand Councillor and commander-in-chief and gave him a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 趙與可除名，令臨安府捕案之。

translations.literal: Zhao Yuke was struck from the registers; Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to arrest and try him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yuke was struck from office, and Lin'an Prefecture was ordered to arrest him.

sentences.zh: 招似道潰兵。

translations.literal: [The court] recruited Sidao's routed troops.
translations.idiomatic: The court called on Jia Sidao's routed troops to reassemble.

sentences.zh: 辛未，右丞相章鑒遁。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Right Chancellor Zhang Jian fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Right Chancellor Zhang Jian fled.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申朔，詔復茶鹽市舶法。

translations.literal: On the first day renshen of the third month, an edict restored the laws on tea, salt, and maritime trade.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, an edict restored the laws governing tea, salt, and maritime trade.

sentences.zh: 似道諸不恤民之政，次第除之，以公田給佃主，令率其租戶爲兵。

translations.literal: Sidao's various policies that showed no concern for the people were abolished one after another; public fields were given to tenant landlords, who were ordered to lead their rent-paying households as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Sidao's policies that had oppressed the people were repealed one by one. Public fields were returned to tenant landlords, who were ordered to lead their tenant households as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 殿前指揮使韓震請遷都，陳宜中殺之。

translations.literal: Han Zhen, Commander of the Palace Front, requested transfer of the capital; Chen Yizhong had him killed.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhen, Commander of the Palace Front, urged moving the capital, and Chen Yizhong had him executed.

sentences.zh: 震所部兵叛，攻嘉會門，射火箭至大內，急發兵捕之，皆散走。

translations.literal: Zhen's troops mutinied, attacked the Jiahui Gate, and shot fire-arrows into the Great Inner Palace; troops were urgently dispatched to capture them, and all scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhen's troops mutinied, attacked the Jiahui Gate, and fired rockets into the inner palace. Troops were sent to suppress them, and the mutineers scattered and fled.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，都統徐旺榮迎大元兵入建康府，鎮江統制石祖忠請降于建康。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Commander Xu Wangrong welcomed Great Yuan troops into Jiankang Prefecture; Shi Zuzhong, controller of Zhenjiang, requested surrender at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Commander Xu Wangrong welcomed Yuan troops into Jiankang, and Shi Zuzhong, controller of Zhenjiang, offered to surrender there.

sentences.zh: 命浙西提刑司準備差遣劉經戍吳江，兩浙轉運司準備差遣羅林、浙西安撫司參議官張濡戍獨松關，山陰縣丞徐垓、正將鬱天興戍四安鎮，起趙淮爲太府寺丞，戍銀樹東壩。

translations.literal: [The court] ordered Prepared Assignee Liu Jing of the Western Zhe Judicial Commission to garrison Wujiang; Prepared Assignee Luo Lin of the Liang-Zhe Transport Commission and Deliberator Zhang Ru of the Western Zhe Pacification Commission to garrison Dusong Pass; Shanyin Assistant Magistrate Xu Gai and Regular Commander Yu Tianxing to garrison Si'an Town; and recalled Zhao Huai as Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury to garrison the eastern dam at Yinshu.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jing of the Western Zhe Judicial Commission was sent to garrison Wujiang; Luo Lin of the Liang-Zhe Transport Commission and Zhang Ru of the Western Zhe Pacification Commission to garrison Dusong Pass; Xu Gai of Shanyin and Yu Tianxing to garrison Si'an; and Zhao Huai was recalled as vice director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury to garrison the eastern dam at Yinshu.

sentences.zh: 湖北安撫司計議官吳繼明攻通城縣，復取之，執縣令以歸。

translations.literal: Wu Jiming, Planning Officer of the Hubei Pacification Commission, attacked Tongcheng County, recovered it, and brought the county magistrate back captive.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jiming, planning officer on the Hubei Pacification Commission, attacked Tongcheng County, recovered it, and brought the magistrate back as a prisoner.

sentences.zh: 遣使召章鑒還朝。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to summon Zhang Jian back to court.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to summon Zhang Jian back to court.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以似道爲醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Sidao was appointed Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Jia Sidao was made Commissioner of the Liquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 大元兵至無錫縣，知縣阮應得出戰，一軍皆沒，應得赴水死。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops reached Wuxi County; Magistrate Ruan Yingde went out to fight; his entire force was destroyed; Yingde threw himself into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces reached Wuxi County. Magistrate Ruan Yingde went out to fight, his entire force was destroyed, and he drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 詔發兵戍吳江。

translations.literal: An edict ordered troops dispatched to garrison Wujiang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered troops sent to garrison Wujiang.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，發兵戍獨松嶺、銅嶺。

translations.literal: On yihai, troops were dispatched to garrison Dusong Ridge and Tong Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, troops were sent to garrison Dusong Ridge and Tong Ridge.

sentences.zh: 詔諭呂文煥、陳奕、範文虎使通和議息兵。

translations.literal: An edict instructed Lü Wenhuan, Chen Yi, and Fan Wenhu to open peace talks and halt hostilities.
translations.idiomatic: An edict instructed Lü Wenhuan, Chen Yi, and Fan Wenhu to open peace negotiations and halt the fighting.

sentences.zh: 以王爚爲左丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Wang Ye was appointed Left Chancellor with concurrent status as Bureau of Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ye was made Left Chancellor and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 閩中地復大震。

translations.literal: The land in Fujian was again shaken by a great earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: A major earthquake again struck Fujian.

sentences.zh: 丙子，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: On bingzi, an edict of self-reproach was issued.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the court issued an edict of self-reproach.

sentences.zh: 以陳宜中爲特進、右丞相兼樞密使。

translations.literal: Chen Yizhong was appointed Special Advanced Grand Master, Right Chancellor, and concurrent Bureau of Military Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yizhong was made Special Advanced Grand Master, Right Chancellor, and Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 罷章鑒官，予祠。

translations.literal: Zhang Jian was removed from office and granted a sinecure.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jian was dismissed from office and given a sinecure.

sentences.zh: 侍御史陳過請竄賈似道並治其党人翁應龍等，不俟報而去。

translations.literal: Attending Censor Chen Guo requested banishment of Jia Sidao and punishment of his factionaries Weng Yinglong and others, then departed without awaiting a reply.
translations.idiomatic: Attending Censor Chen Guo asked that Jia Sidao be banished and his associates Weng Yinglong and others punished, then left without waiting for a reply.

sentences.zh: 監察御史潘文卿、季可乞從過所請，乃命捕應龍下臨安府獄。

translations.literal: Investigating Censors Pan Wenqing and Ji Ke requested assent to Guo's petition; [the court] then ordered Yinglong arrested and imprisoned in Lin'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censors Pan Wenqing and Ji Ke supported Chen Guo's request, and the court ordered Weng Yinglong arrested and imprisoned in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 罷廖瑩中、王庭、劉良貴、游汶、朱浚、陳伯大、董樸。

translations.literal: Liao Yingzhong, Wang Ting, Liu Lianggui, You Wen, Zhu Jun, Chen Boda, and Dong Pu were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Liao Yingzhong, Wang Ting, Liu Lianggui, You Wen, Zhu Jun, Chen Boda, and Dong Pu were all dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 責洪起畏鎮江自效。

translations.literal: Hong Qiwei was charged to redeem himself at Zhenjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Qiwei was ordered to redeem himself by defending Zhenjiang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，知滁州王應龍以城降。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Wang Yinglong, prefect of Chuzhou, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Wang Yinglong, prefect of Chuzhou, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 己卯，杖翁應龍，刺配吉陽軍。

translations.literal: On jimao, Weng Yinglong was beaten with the rod and tattooed and banished to the Jiyang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Weng Yinglong was flogged, tattooed, and banished to the Jiyang Army.

sentences.zh: 命王爚、陳宜中並都督諸路軍馬。

translations.literal: [The court] ordered Wang Ye and Chen Yizhong jointly to command all military forces of the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ye and Chen Yizhong were jointly ordered to command all armies.

sentences.zh: 加呂文福福州觀察使。

translations.literal: Lü Wenfu was advanced to Regional Inspector of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wenfu was promoted to Regional Inspector of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，贈唐震華文閣待制。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Tang Zhen was posthumously enfeoffed as Attendant Gentleman of the Huawen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Tang Zhen was posthumously made Attendant Gentleman of the Huawen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 削萬道同三官，罷之。

translations.literal: Wan Datong was stripped of three ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Datong was stripped of three ranks and dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬午，復吳潛、向士璧官。

translations.literal: On renwu, Wu Qian and Xiang Shibi were restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Wu Qian and Xiang Shibi were restored to office.

sentences.zh: 知常州趙與鑒聞兵至遁，常民錢訔以城降。

translations.literal: Zhao Yujian, prefect of Changzhou, fled on hearing that troops had arrived; the Changzhou commoner Qian Yin surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yujian, prefect of Changzhou, fled when he heard the army was coming, and the commoner Qian Yin surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大元兵至西海州，安撫丁順降。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Great Yuan troops reached Xihai Prefecture; Pacification Commissioner Ding Shun surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Yuan forces reached Xihai Prefecture, and Pacification Commissioner Ding Shun surrendered.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，知東海州施居文乞降於西海州。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Shi Juwen, prefect of Donghai Prefecture, requested surrender at Xihai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Shi Juwen, prefect of Donghai, asked to surrender at Xihai.

sentences.zh: 知平江府潛說友、通判胡玉、林鏜以城降。

translations.literal: Qian Shuiyou, prefect of Pingjiang; Vice Prefects Hu Yu and Lin Qiang—all surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Shuiyou, prefect of Pingjiang, and Vice Prefects Hu Yu and Lin Qiang all surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 加張世傑保康軍承宣使，總都督府諸軍。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie was advanced to Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army and placed in overall command of all armies at the Commandery Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie was promoted to Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army and placed in overall command of all armies at the command headquarters.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，知廣德軍令狐概以城降。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Linghu Gai, prefect of the Guangde Army, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Linghu Gai, prefect of the Guangde Army, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 徙浙西提點刑獄司於平江府。

translations.literal: The Western Zhe Judicial Intendant Commission was transferred to Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Zhe Judicial Intendant Commission was moved to Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 張世傑遣其將閻順、李存進軍廣德，謝洪永進軍平江，李山進軍常州。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie dispatched his generals Yan Shun and Li Cun to advance on Guangde, Xie Hongyong to advance on Pingjiang, and Li Shan to advance on Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie sent his generals Yan Shun and Li Cun against Guangde, Xie Hongyong against Pingjiang, and Li Shan against Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，張德以下各轉官有差。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Zhang De and those below him were each advanced in rank by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Zhang De and his subordinates were each promoted by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 謝元等贈十官。

translations.literal: Xie Yuan and others were posthumously granted ten ranks of office.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Yuan and others were posthumously granted ten ranks of office.

sentences.zh: 有星二斗于中天，頃之，一星隕。

translations.literal: Two stars grappled at mid-heaven; presently one star fell.
translations.idiomatic: Two stars grappled at mid-heaven; soon one fell.

sentences.zh: 己丑，滁人執王應龍歸於揚州，殺之。

translations.literal: On jichou, the people of Chuzhou seized Wang Yinglong and brought him to Yangzhou, where he was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, the people of Chuzhou seized Wang Yinglong, brought him to Yangzhou, and killed him.

sentences.zh: 加呂文福保康軍承宣使，趣入衛。

translations.literal: Lü Wenfu was advanced to Vice Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army and urged to enter the capital for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Wenfu was promoted to Vice Commissioner-in-Chief of the Baokang Army and ordered to hurry to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 文福至饒州，殺使者，入江州降大元。

translations.literal: Wenfu reached Raozhou, killed the envoy, entered Jiangzhou, and surrendered to the Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wenfu reached Raozhou, killed the envoy, went into Jiangzhou, and surrendered to the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，左司諫潘文卿、右正言季可、同知樞密院曾淵子、兩浙轉運副使許自、浙東安撫王霖龍相繼皆遁。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Left Remonstrator Pan Wenqing, Right Rectifier Li Ke, Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zeng Yuanzi, Liang-Zhe Transport Vice Commissioner Xu Zi, and Eastern Zhe Pacification Commissioner Wang Linlong successively all fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Left Remonstrator Pan Wenqing, Right Rectifier Li Ke, Vice Director Zeng Yuanzi, Liang-Zhe Transport Vice Commissioner Xu Zi, and Eastern Zhe Pacification Commissioner Wang Linlong fled one after another.

sentences.zh: 簽書樞密院文及翁、同簽書樞密院倪普諷台臣劾己，章未上，亟出關遁。

translations.literal: Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs Wen Jiweng and Concurrent Secretary Ni Pu incited censorial officials to impeach themselves; before the memorial was submitted, they hastily fled beyond the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Secretaries Wen Jiweng and Ni Pu of the Bureau of Military Affairs urged the censors to impeach them; before the memorial went up, they fled beyond the passes.

sentences.zh: 知安東州孫嗣武以城降。

translations.literal: Sun Siwu, prefect of Andong Prefecture, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Siwu, prefect of Andong, surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 雨土。

translations.literal: Earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Dust fell like rain.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命在京文武官並轉兩官，其畔官而遁者，令御史臺覺察以聞。

translations.literal: On xinmao, all civil and military officials in the capital were ordered advanced two ranks; those who had rebelled in office and fled were to be detected by the Censorate and reported.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, all civil and military officials in the capital were promoted two ranks; deserters who had abandoned their posts were to be detected by the Censorate and reported.

sentences.zh: 閻順戰安吉縣，復取鳳平。

translations.literal: Yan Shun fought at Anji County and recovered Fengping.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Shun fought at Anji County and recovered Fengping.

sentences.zh: 張濡部曲害大元行人嚴忠范于獨松關，執廉希賢至臨安，重創死。

translations.literal: Zhang Ru's retainers killed the Great Yuan traveler Yan Zhongfan at Dusong Pass; they seized Lian Xixian and brought him to Lin'an, where he died of grave wounds.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Ru's troops killed the Yuan envoy Yan Zhongfan at Dusong Pass, seized Lian Xixian, and brought him to Lin'an, where he died of his wounds.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，岳州安撫高世傑軍洞庭中，大元兵攻之，世傑降。

translations.literal: On renchen, Yuezhou Pacification Commissioner Gao Shijie had his army in Lake Dongting; Great Yuan troops attacked him, and Shijie surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yuezhou Pacification Commissioner Gao Shijie was encamped on Lake Dongting; Yuan forces attacked, and he surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，攻岳州，總制孟之紹以城降。

translations.literal: On guisi, [they] attacked Yuezhou; Commander Meng Zhishao surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Yuezhou was attacked, and Commander Meng Zhishao surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔褒諭張世傑、閻順，諸將各轉官有差。

translations.literal: On jiawu, an edict commended Zhang Shijie and Yan Shun; the various generals were each advanced in rank by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, an edict commended Zhang Shijie and Yan Shun, and the various generals were each promoted by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙未，免安吉縣今年夏 田租，有戰沒者，縣令、丞恤之。

translations.literal: On yiwei, this year's summer field rent for Anji County was remitted; for those killed in battle, the magistrate and vice magistrate were to provide condolence payments.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Anji County's summer field rent for this year was remitted, and the magistrate and vice magistrate were to provide for the families of those killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 丙申，顧順攻廣德軍，復取之。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Gu Shun attacked the Guangde Army and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Gu Shun attacked the Guangde Army and recovered it.

sentences.zh: 以陳合同簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Chen Tong was appointed Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Tong was appointed Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，贈邊居誼利州觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Bian Juyi was posthumously enfeoffed as Regional Inspector of Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Bian Juyi was posthumously made Regional Inspector of Lizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，赦邊城降將罪，能自拔而歸者錄之，復一州者予知州，復一縣者予知縣，所部僚吏將卒及土豪立功者同賞。

translations.literal: On wuxu, amnesty was granted for the crimes of frontier surrendered generals; those who could extricate themselves and return would be entered on the rolls; whoever recovered one prefecture would be made its prefect, whoever recovered one county would be made its magistrate; subordinate officials, officers, soldiers, and local magnates who achieved merit would share in the reward.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, surrendered frontier generals were pardoned; those who could break free and return would be recorded. Whoever recovered a prefecture would be made its prefect, whoever recovered a county its magistrate, and subordinates and local leaders who distinguished themselves would share the reward.

sentences.zh: 罷章鑒祠官並奪宰輔恩數，曾淵子削兩官，奪執政恩數，陳過、陳堅、徐卿孫各削兩官，奪侍從恩數。

translations.literal: Zhang Jian's sinecure was abolished and his grand councilor perquisites were stripped; Zeng Yuanzi was stripped of two ranks and his executive perquisites were stripped; Chen Guo, Chen Jian, and Xu Qingsun were each stripped of two ranks and their attendant perquisites were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jian was stripped of his sinecure and grand councilor perquisites; Zeng Yuanzi was demoted two ranks and stripped of executive perquisites; Chen Guo, Chen Jian, and Xu Qingsun were each demoted two ranks and stripped of attendant perquisites.

sentences.zh: 趙與鑒追兩官罷之，遇赦永不收敘。

translations.literal: Zhao Yujian was posthumously stripped of two ranks and dismissed; even on amnesty he would never be restored.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yujian was posthumously demoted two ranks and dismissed; even under amnesty he would never be restored to office.

sentences.zh: 罷許自、王霖龍。

translations.literal: Xu Zi and Wang Linlong were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zi and Wang Linlong were dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 令淮東制置司用標由。

translations.literal: [The court] ordered the Huaidong Pacification Commission to use tally warrants.
translations.idiomatic: The Huaidong Pacification Commission was ordered to issue tally warrants.

sentences.zh: 庚子，徙淮東總領所于江陰軍。

translations.literal: On gengzi, the Huaidong General Supplies Office was transferred to the Jiangyin Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the Huaidong General Supplies Office was moved to the Jiangyin Army.

sentences.zh: 加吳繼明閣門宣贊舍人。

translations.literal: Wu Jiming was advanced to Gate Troop Commendation Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jiming was promoted to Gate Troop Commendation Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 四月壬寅朔，贈趙卯發華文閣待制。

translations.literal: On the first day renyin of the fourth month, Zhao Maofa was posthumously enfeoffed as Attendant Gentleman of the Huawen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month, Zhao Maofa was posthumously made Attendant Gentleman of the Huawen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 貶陳過平江府。

translations.literal: Chen Guo was demoted to Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Guo was demoted and sent to Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 雄江軍統制洪福率衆復鎮巢軍。

translations.literal: Hong Fu, controller of the Xiongjian Army, led the multitude to recover the Zhenchao Army.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Fu, controller of the Xiongjian Army, led his troops to recover Zhenchao.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，贈江萬里太師，諡文忠，輟視朝二日。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Jiang Wanli was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Preceptor with the posthumous title Wenzhong; court audiences were suspended for two days.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Jiang Wanli was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with the posthumous title Wenzhong, and court audiences were suspended for two days.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，大元兵入廣德縣，知縣王汝翼與寓居官趙時晦率義兵戰鬥山，路分孟唐老與其二子皆死，汝翼被執，至建康死之。

translations.literal: On yisi, Great Yuan troops entered Guangde County; Magistrate Wang Ruyi and Resident Official Zhao Shihui led militia to battle at Mount Dou; Route Commander Meng Tanglao and his two sons all died; Ruyi was seized and died at Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Yuan forces entered Guangde County. Magistrate Wang Ruyi and resident official Zhao Shihui led militia to fight at Mount Dou. Route Commander Meng Tanglao and his two sons were all killed. Ruyi was captured and died at Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 王大用贈三官，王虎臣贈兩官，官其二子。

translations.literal: Wang Dayong was posthumously granted three ranks of office, Wang Huchen two ranks; his two sons were given office.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dayong was posthumously granted three ranks of office and Wang Huchen two; their two sons were given office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，大元兵破沙市城，都統孟紀死之，監鎮司馬夢求自經死。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Great Yuan troops breached Shashi city; Commander Meng Ji died in the fighting; Garrison Supervisor Sima Mengqiu hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yuan forces breached Shashi. Commander Meng Ji was killed, and Garrison Supervisor Sima Mengqiu hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 戊申，京湖宣撫朱禩孫、湖北制置副使高達以江陵降，京湖北路相繼皆下。

translations.literal: On wushen, Jing-Hu Pacification Commissioner Zhu Yisun and Hubei Pacification Vice Commissioner Gao Da surrendered Jiangling; Jing-Hu North Circuit fell in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Jing-Hu Pacification Commissioner Zhu Yisun and Hubei Vice Commissioner Gao Da surrendered Jiangling, and Jing-Hu North Circuit fell in succession.

sentences.zh: 張起岩提兵保飛山。

translations.literal: Zhang Qiyan led troops to hold Feishan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qiyan led troops to hold Feishan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命劉師勇戍平江府。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Liu Shiyong was ordered to garrison Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Liu Shiyong was ordered to garrison Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，顧順諸將各轉三官，孟唐老贈三官。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Gu Shun's generals were each advanced three ranks; Meng Tanglao was posthumously granted three ranks of office.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Gu Shun's generals were each promoted three ranks, and Meng Tanglao was posthumously granted three ranks of office.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以高斯得簽書樞密院事權參知政事。

translations.literal: On renzi, Gao Side was appointed Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs with acting status as Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Gao Side was appointed Secretary of the Bureau of Military Affairs with acting status as Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 總統張敏與大元兵戰豐城，死之。

translations.literal: Commander-in-Chief Zhang Min fought Great Yuan troops at Fengcheng and died.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-Chief Zhang Min fought Yuan forces at Fengcheng and was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，贈五官，官其一子。

translations.literal: On guichou, [he was] posthumously granted five ranks of office, and one son was given office.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, he was posthumously granted five ranks of office, and one son was given office.

sentences.zh: 阮應得贈十官。

translations.literal: Ruan Yingde was posthumously granted ten ranks of office.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Yingde was posthumously granted ten ranks of office.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以福王與芮爲武康、寧江軍節度使、判紹興府。

translations.literal: On yimao, Prince of Fu Zhao Yourui was made Military Commissioner of the Wukang and Ningjiang armies with concurrent status as Administrator of Shaoxing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Prince of Fu Zhao Yourui was made Military Commissioner of the Wukang and Ningjiang armies and Administrator of Shaoxing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，王爚來，令如文彥博故事，自朝參起居外並免拜。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Wang Ye arrived; he was ordered to follow the precedent of Wen Yanbo—from attendance at morning audience and the emperor's rising onward, all bows were waived.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Wang Ye arrived and was granted the same courtesies as Wen Yanbo: aside from attendance at morning audience and the emperor's rising, he was excused from all bows.

sentences.zh: 以樞密副使召夏貴提兵入衛。

translations.literal: As Vice Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Xia Gui was summoned to lead troops to the capital for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Xia Gui was summoned to bring his troops to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，總制霍祖勝攻溧陽縣，復取之。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Commander Huo Zusheng attacked Liyang County and recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Commander Huo Zusheng attacked Liyang County and recovered it.

sentences.zh: 戊午，贈張資眉州防禦使，侯興復州團練使。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Zhang Zi was posthumously enfeoffed as Defender of Meizhou; Hou Xing as Commandant of Fuzhou Regiment Training.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zhang Zi was posthumously made Defender of Meizhou and Hou Xing Commandant of Fuzhou Regiment Training.

sentences.zh: 乙未，文及翁、倪普並削一官，奪執政恩數；

translations.literal: On yiwei, Wen Jiweng and Ni Pu were each stripped of one rank and their executive perquisites were stripped;
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Wen Jiweng and Ni Pu were each demoted one rank and stripped of executive perquisites;

sentences.zh: 潛說友削三官，奪侍從恩數。

translations.literal: Qian Shuiyou was stripped of three ranks and his attendant perquisites were stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Shuiyou was demoted three ranks and stripped of attendant perquisites.

sentences.zh: 庚申，令狐概除名、配郁林州牢城，籍其家。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Linghu Gai was struck from the registers, banished to the prison fortress of Yulin Prefecture, and his household was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Linghu Gai was struck from the registers, banished to the Yulin prison fortress, and his property was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 知金壇縣李成大率義局官含山縣尉胡傳心、陽春主簿潘大同、濠梁主簿潘大㮺、進士潘文孫潘應奎攻金壇縣，取之。

translations.literal: Li Chengda, magistrate of Jintan County, led Righteousness Bureau officials—Hanshan County Vice Magistrate Hu Chuanxin, Yangchun Registrar Pan Datong, Haoliang Registrar Pan Dabo, and Presented Scholars Pan Wensun and Pan Yingkui—to attack Jintan County and take it.
