translations.idiomatic: Li Chengda, magistrate of Jintan, led the Righteousness Bureau officials Hu Chuanxin, Pan Datong, Pan Dabo, Pan Wensun, and Pan Yingkui in an attack on Jintan County and took it.

sentences.zh: 鎮江統制侯岩、縣尉趙嗣濱復助大元兵來戰，成大二子及大同等皆死，執成大以歸。

translations.literal: Zhenjiang Controller Hou Yan and County Vice Magistrate Zhao Sibin again came to aid Great Yuan troops in battle; Chengda's two sons and Datong and the others all died; Chengda was seized and taken back.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenjiang Controller Hou Yan and County Vice Magistrate Zhao Sibin again aided Yuan forces in battle. Chengda's two sons and Datong and the others were all killed, and Chengda was captured.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大元兵攻真州，知州苗再成、宗子趙孟錦率兵大戰於老鸛觜。

translations.literal: On renxu, Great Yuan troops attacked Zhenzhou; Prefect Miao Zaicheng and imperial clansman Zhao Mengjin led troops in a great battle at Laoguanzui.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yuan forces attacked Zhenzhou. Prefect Miao Zaicheng and imperial clansman Zhao Mengjin led a great battle at Laoguanzui.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，加知思州田謹賢、知播州楊邦憲並復州團練使，趣兵入衛。

translations.literal: On guihai, Tian Jinxian, prefect of Sizhou, and Yang Bangxian, prefect of Bozhou, were each advanced to Commandant of Fuzhou Regiment Training and urged to bring troops to the capital for defense.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Tian Jinxian of Sizhou and Yang Bangxian of Bozhou were each promoted to Commandant of Fuzhou Regiment Training and ordered to hurry their troops to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 有大星自心東北流入濁沒。

translations.literal: A great star flowed from northeast of the Heart [constellation] and sank into obscurity.
translations.idiomatic: A great star streamed from northeast of the Heart and vanished into the murk.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，熒惑犯天江。

translations.literal: On yichou, Mars trespassed against Tianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Mars trespassed against Tianjiang.

sentences.zh: 提舉太平興國宮常楙請立濟王后。

translations.literal: Palace Commissioner Chang Mao of the Taiping Xingguo Palace memorialized requesting installation of a Prince of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Mao, commissioner of the Taiping Xingguo Palace, memorialized asking that a Prince of Ji be installed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，加李庭芝參知政事。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Li Tingzhi was advanced to Vice Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Li Tingzhi was promoted to Vice Grand Councillor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔宜興、溧陽民兵助戰有功，特免今年田租。

translations.literal: On wuchen, an edict stated that militia of Yixing and Liyang who aided battle with merit were specially exempted from this year's field rent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, an edict exempted this year's field rent for the militia of Yixing and Liyang who had fought with merit.

sentences.zh: 江陰民被兵，其租亦勿收責。

translations.literal: The people of Jiangyin had suffered warfare; their rent likewise was not to be collected or exacted.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jiangyin had also suffered warfare, and their rents were not to be collected.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大元兵至揚子橋，揚州都撥發官雷大震出戰死。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Great Yuan troops reached Yangzi Bridge; Yangzhou Chief Dispatch Officer Lei Dazhen went out to battle and died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Yuan forces reached Yangzi Bridge. Yangzhou Chief Dispatch Officer Lei Dazhen went out to fight and was killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，常德、鼎、澧皆降。

translations.literal: That month, Changde, Ding, and Li all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Changde, Ding, and Li all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未朔，命宰執日赴朝堂治事。

translations.literal: On the first day xinwei of the fifth month, the grand councilors were ordered to attend court daily in the Hall of Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, the grand councilors were ordered to attend court daily in the Hall of Governance.

sentences.zh: 旌德縣城守有功，免其民今年田租。

translations.literal: For meritorious defense of Jingde county seat, that county's people were exempted from this year's field rent.
translations.idiomatic: For meritorious defense of Jingde, its people were exempted from this year's field rent.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，大元兵至寧國縣，知縣趙與䅯出戰死。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Great Yuan troops reached Ningguo County; Magistrate Zhao Yurui went out to battle and died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Yuan forces reached Ningguo County. Magistrate Zhao Yurui went out to fight and was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，淮安總制李宗榮、知慶遠府仇子真將兵來勤王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Huai'an Commander Li Zongrong and Qingyuan Prefecture Prefect Qiu Zizhen led troops to muster in defense of the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Huai'an Commander Li Zongrong and Qingyuan Prefect Qiu Zizhen marched their troops to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，加苗再成濠州團練使，趙孟錦揚州都統司計議官。

translations.literal: On yihai, Miao Zaicheng was advanced to Commandant of Haozhou Regiment Training; Zhao Mengjin was made Planning Officer of the Yangzhou Grand Command Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Miao Zaicheng was promoted to Commandant of Haozhou Regiment Training, and Zhao Mengjin was made planning officer on the Yangzhou Grand Command staff.

sentences.zh: 以洪福知鎮巢軍。

translations.literal: Hong Fu was appointed prefect of the Zhenchao Army.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Fu was appointed prefect of the Zhenchao Army.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔趙溍統軍民船屯江陰。

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict ordered Zhao Jin to assemble military and civilian boats and encamp at Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, an edict ordered Zhao Jin to assemble military and civilian vessels and encamp at Jiangyin.

sentences.zh: 劉師勇攻常州，復取之，執安撫戴之泰，司戶趙必佮、總管陸春戰死。

translations.literal: Liu Shiyong attacked Changzhou, recovered it, seized Pacification Commissioner Dai Zhitan; Registrar Zhao Biyi and Superintendent Lu Chun died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shiyong attacked Changzhou and recovered it, seizing Pacification Commissioner Dai Zhitan. Registrar Zhao Biyi and Superintendent Lu Chun were killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，淮東兵馬鈐轄阮克己將兵來勤王，加左驍騎中郎將。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Huaidong Military Credential Commissioner Ruan Keji led troops to muster in defense of the throne and was advanced to Left Valiant Cavalry Cadet-General.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Huaidong Military Credential Commissioner Ruan Keji marched to the capital's defense and was promoted to Left Valiant Cavalry Cadet-General.

sentences.zh: 己卯，賜婺州處士何基諡文定，王柏承事郎。

translations.literal: On jimao, the retired gentleman of Wuzhou He Ji was given the posthumous title Wendi; Wang Bai was made Court Gentleman for Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the Wuzhou recluse He Ji was given the posthumous title Wendi, and Wang Bai was made Court Gentleman for Attendance.

sentences.zh: 加張珏檢校少保、四川制置副使、知重慶府。

translations.literal: Zhang Jue was advanced to Acting Junior Mentor, Sichuan Pacification Vice Commissioner, and concurrent Prefect of Chongqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jue was promoted to Acting Junior Mentor, Sichuan Pacification Vice Commissioner, and concurrent prefect of Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，贈雷大震保康軍節度使。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Lei Dazhen was posthumously enfeoffed as Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Lei Dazhen was posthumously made Military Commissioner of the Baokang Army.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，加劉師勇濠州團練使，其將劉圭以下各轉官有差。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Liu Shiyong was advanced to Commandant of Haozhou Regiment Training; his generals Liu Gui and those below were each advanced in rank by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Liu Shiyong was promoted to Commandant of Haozhou Regiment Training, and his generals Liu Gui and others were each promoted by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊子，贈潘大同等官，余有功人並轉兩官。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Pan Datong and others were posthumously granted office; the remaining meritorious persons were all advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Pan Datong and others were posthumously granted office, and the remaining meritorious persons were each promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，貶潛說友南安軍，吳益汀州，並籍其家。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Qian Shuiyou was demoted to Nan'an Army and Wu Yi to Tingzhou; their households were both confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Qian Shuiyou was demoted to Nan'an and Wu Yi to Tingzhou, and both their properties were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 罷李珏，送婺州。

translations.literal: Li Jue was dismissed and sent to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jue was dismissed and sent to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 籍呂文煥、孟之縉、陳奕、範文虎家。

translations.literal: The households of Lü Wenhan, Meng Zhijin, Chen Yi, and Fan Wenhu were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: The properties of Lü Wenhan, Meng Zhijin, Chen Yi, and Fan Wenhu were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 甲午，饒、信州饑，令民入粟補官。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Raozhou and Xinzhou suffered famine; the people were permitted to submit grain for office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Raozhou and Xinzhou suffered famine, and the people were permitted to buy office with grain.

sentences.zh: 罷市舶分司，令通判任舶事。

translations.literal: The Maritime Trade Subcommission was abolished; vice prefects were to take charge of shipping affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Maritime Trade Subcommission was abolished, and vice prefects were put in charge of shipping affairs.

sentences.zh: 淮東、西官民兵各轉一官。

translations.literal: Huaidong and Huaidong-West official militia were each advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Huaidong and Huaidong-West official militia were each promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔張世傑、張彥、阮克己、仇子真四道出兵、遣使告天地、宗廟、社稷諸陵、宮觀。

translations.literal: On bingshen, an edict ordered Zhang Shijie, Zhang Yan, Ruan Keji, and Qiu Zizhen to lead troops in four directions; envoys were dispatched to announce to Heaven, the ancestral temples, the altars of soil and grain, the imperial tombs, and palace abbeys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, an edict ordered Zhang Shijie, Zhang Yan, Ruan Keji, and Qiu Zizhen to march in four directions, and envoys were sent to announce the campaign to Heaven, the ancestral temples, the altars of soil and grain, the imperial tombs, and the palace abbeys.

sentences.zh: 己亥，勞軍。

translations.literal: On jihai, the troops were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the troops were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 吳繼明復蒲圻、通城、崇陽三縣，加帶行帶御器械、權知鄂州，令擇險爲寓治。

translations.literal: Wu Jiming recovered Puchi, Tongcheng, and Chongyang counties; he was advanced to Acting Bearer of the Imperial Armory with Traveling Insignia and Acting Prefect of Ezhou, and ordered to choose a defensible place as temporary seat of government.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jiming recovered Puchi, Tongcheng, and Chongyang and was promoted to Acting Bearer of the Imperial Armory with Traveling Insignia and Acting Prefect of Ezhou, with orders to choose a defensible place as his temporary seat.

sentences.zh: 贈鮑廉直華文閣，官其一子；

translations.literal: Bao Lian was posthumously enfeoffed as Direct Attendant of the Huawen Pavilion, and one son was given office;
translations.idiomatic: Bao Lian was posthumously made Direct Attendant of the Huawen Pavilion, and one son was given office;

sentences.zh: 趙與䅯直華文閣。

translations.literal: Zhao Yurui was made Direct Attendant of the Huawen Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yurui was made Direct Attendant of the Huawen Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子朔，日有食之，既，晝晦如夜。

translations.literal: On the first day gengzi of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun that was total; daytime grew dark as night.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month there was a total eclipse of the sun, and day turned dark as night.

sentences.zh: 昝萬壽以嘉定及三龜、九頂、紫雲城降。

translations.literal: Zan Wanshou surrendered Jiading together with San'gui, Jiuding, and Ziyun cities.
translations.idiomatic: Zan Wanshou surrendered Jiading along with the cities of San'gui, Jiuding, and Ziyun.

sentences.zh: 知敘州李演將兵援嘉定府，遂解歸，戰羊雅江，兵敗被執。

translations.literal: Li Yan, prefect of Xuzhou, led troops to relieve Jiading Prefecture, then returned after the siege was lifted; he fought at the Yangya River, was defeated, and seized.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yan, prefect of Xuzhou, led troops to relieve Jiading, then withdrew after the siege lifted. He fought at the Yangya River, was defeated, and captured.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太皇太后詔削尊號「聖福」字以應天戒。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Grand Empress Dowager issued an edict stripping the honorific characters "Shengfu" from her title in response to Heaven's warning.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the Grand Empress Dowager issued an edict removing the honorific "Shengfu" from her title in response to Heaven's warning.

sentences.zh: 復魏克愚官，太學生蕭規、唐棣並補承信郎。

translations.literal: Wei Keyu's office was restored; Imperial University students Xiao Gui and Tang Di were both made Trustworthy Gentlemen.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Keyu was restored to office, and Imperial University students Xiao Gui and Tang Di were both made Trustworthy Gentlemen.

sentences.zh: 知嘉興府余安裕坐聞兵求去，貽書朝中，語涉不道，削一官送徽州。

translations.literal: Yu Anyu, prefect of Jiaxing, was dismissed for seeking leave on hearing of troops; he sent a letter to court with improper language; he was stripped of one rank and sent to Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Anyu, prefect of Jiaxing, resigned on hearing that troops were coming and sent the court a letter with improper language. He was demoted one rank and sent to Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 徐卿孫削一官貶吉州。

translations.literal: Xu Qingsun was stripped of one rank and demoted to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Qingsun was demoted one rank and sent to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 命侍從官已上各舉才堪文武者五人，餘廷臣各舉三人，雖在謫籍，亦聽舉之。

translations.literal: Attendant ministers and above were each ordered to recommend five persons capable in both civil and military affairs; the remaining courtiers each three persons; even those on the demotion register might be recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant ministers and above were each ordered to recommend five persons capable in civil and military affairs, and the remaining courtiers three each; even those on the demotion register might be nominated.

sentences.zh: 丙午，王應麟言：「開慶之禍，始于丁大全，請凡大全之黨，在謫籍者皆勿宥。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Wang Yinglin said: "The disaster of Kaixi began with Ding Daquan; I request that all of Daquan's party on the demotion register not be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Wang Yinglin said, "The disaster of Kaixi began with Ding Daquan. I ask that none of Daquan's party on the demotion register be pardoned.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: "[The court] assented."
translations.idiomatic: The court assented.

sentences.zh: 己酉，免廣德軍今年田租及諸郡縣未納綱解。

translations.literal: On jiyou, this year's field rent for the Guangde Army and outstanding tribute deliveries of various prefectures and counties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, this year's field rent for the Guangde Army and unpaid tribute deliveries from the various prefectures and counties were remitted.

sentences.zh: 王應麟繳還章鑒、曾淵子錄黃，言韓震爲逆，二人實芘之；

translations.literal: Wang Yinglin returned Zhang Jian's and Zeng Yuanzi's recorded yellows, stating that Han Zhen was a traitor and the two men had in fact sheltered him;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yinglin returned Zhang Jian's and Zeng Yuanzi's recorded memorials, saying that Han Zhen had been a traitor and the two men had in fact sheltered him;

sentences.zh: 且淵子芘翁應龍致有逸罰，又嘗竊府庫金以遁。

translations.literal: Moreover, Yuanzi had sheltered Weng Yinglong, which led to lenient punishment; [Weng] had also once stolen gold from the prefectural treasury and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Yuanzi had sheltered Weng Yinglong, which led to a lighter penalty; Weng Yinglong had also once stolen gold from the prefectural treasury and fled.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命削鑒一官，放歸田里，淵子再削一官，徙吉州，誅翁應龍，籍其家。

translations.literal: On gengxu, [the court] ordered Jian stripped of one rank and released to his home village; Yuanzi stripped of one further rank and exiled to Jizhou; Weng Yinglong executed and his household property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhang Jian was demoted one rank and sent home; Zeng Yuanzi was demoted one further rank and exiled to Jizhou; Weng Yinglong was executed and his property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，銓試。

translations.literal: On xinhai, selection examination.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the selection examination was held.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，留夢炎入朝，王爚請相夢炎，乞以經筵備顧問，陳宜中請相夢炎，乞祠，詔二相毋藉此求閑。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Liu Mengyan entered court; Wang Huo requested Mengyan as chief minister, asking to serve at the classical lectures as consultant; Chen Yizhong requested Mengyan as chief minister, asking for a temple appointment; an edict said the two chief ministers must not use this to seek leisure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Liu Mengyan came to court. Wang Huo asked that Mengyan be made chief minister and serve at the classical lectures as a consultant; Chen Yizhong also asked that Mengyan be made chief minister, but sought a temple appointment for himself. An edict forbade the two chief ministers from using these requests to seek leisure posts.

sentences.zh: 以爚爲平章軍國重事，一月兩赴經筵，五日一朝；

translations.literal: Huo was made Coordinator of State and Military Affairs, twice monthly attending the classical lectures, court audience every five days;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huo was appointed Coordinator of State and Military Affairs, to attend the classical lectures twice a month and hold court audience every five days;

sentences.zh: 宜中左丞相兼樞密使，都督諸路兵；

translations.literal: Yizhong [was] left chief minister concurrent Bureau Director, commander-in-chief of all circuit troops;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yizhong was left chief minister and concurrent Bureau Director, with overall command of troops in all circuits;

sentences.zh: 夢炎右丞相兼樞密使，都督諸路兵。

translations.literal: Mengyan [was] right chief minister concurrent Bureau Director, commander-in-chief of all circuit troops.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mengyan was right chief minister and concurrent Bureau Director, with overall command of troops in all circuits.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔求言。

translations.literal: On yimao, an edict solicited remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the court issued an edict soliciting advice.

sentences.zh: 知敘州郭漢傑以城降。

translations.literal: Guo Hanjie, prefect of Xuzhou, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Hanjie, the prefect of Xuzhou, surrendered the city to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，疏決在京罪人。

translations.literal: On bingchen, review and sentencing of capital offenders.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, capital prisoners were reviewed and sentenced.

sentences.zh: 免引見。

translations.literal: Court presentations were waived.
translations.idiomatic: Presentations at court were waived.

sentences.zh: 戊午，知瀘州梅應春以城降。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Mei Yingchun, prefect of Luzhou, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Mei Yingchun, prefect of Luzhou, handed the city over.

sentences.zh: 己未，以李庭芝知樞密院事兼參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Li Tingzhi was made Bureau Director and Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Li Tingzhi was appointed Bureau Director and Vice Councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，知富順監王宗義以城降。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Wang Zongyi, intendant of Fushun, surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Wang Zongyi, intendant of Fushun, surrendered his post and the city.

sentences.zh: 王應麟復繳還曾淵子貶吉州錄黃，癸亥，貶韶州。

translations.literal: Wang Yinglin again returned Zeng Yuanzi's recorded yellow on demotion to Jizhou; on guihai [Yuanzi] was demoted to Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yinglin again returned Zeng Yuanzi's recorded memorial on his demotion to Jizhou; on guihai Yuanzi was demoted to Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吳繼明諸將各轉官有差。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Wu Jiming and other generals were each advanced in rank by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Wu Jiming and his generals were each promoted by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，朱禩孫除名，籍其家。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Zhu Tisun was removed from the registers and his household property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhu Tisun was struck from the registers and his property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午朔，江西制置黃萬石移治撫州，詔還隆興府。

translations.literal: Seventh month, autumn, gengwu new moon: Jiangxi Commissioner Huang Wanshi moved his headquarters to Fuzhou; an edict ordered him back to Longxing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month of autumn, Jiangxi Commissioner Huang Wanshi moved his headquarters to Fuzhou; the court ordered him to return to Longxing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛未，張世傑諸軍戰焦山下，敗績。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Zhang Shijie's armies fought below Jiaoshan and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Zhang Shijie's forces fought below Jiaoshan and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，徙似道居婺州，廖瑩中除名貶昭州，王庭除名貶梅州，徙曾淵子雷州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Sidao was exiled to reside in Wuzhou; Liao Yingzhong was removed from the registers and demoted to Shaozhou; Wang Ting was removed from the registers and demoted to Meizhou; Yuanzi was exiled to Leizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Jia Sidao was exiled to Wuzhou; Liao Yingzhong was struck from the registers and sent to Shaozhou; Wang Ting was struck from the registers and sent to Meizhou; Zeng Yuanzi was exiled to Leizhou.

sentences.zh: 寧國吏楊義忠率義兵出戰死，乙亥，贈武功大夫。

translations.literal: Ningguo clerk Yang Yizhong led righteous militia out to fight and died; on yihai he was posthumously granted Grand Master of Martial Achievements.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yizhong, a Ningguo clerk, led local militia into battle and was killed; on yihai he was posthumously made Grand Master of Martial Achievements.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，徙似道建寧府。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Sidao was exiled to Jianning prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Jia Sidao was exiled to Jianning prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太白入東井。

translations.literal: Great White entered the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Venus entered the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 庚申，加知高郵軍褚一正〔五〕閣門宣贊舍人，知懷遠軍金之才帶御器械，知安淮軍高福閣門祗候，知泗州譚與閣門宣贊舍人，知濠州孫立右衛大將軍，賞守邊功。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Chu Yizheng, Gaoyou Army commander, was promoted to Palace Gate Proclamation Cadet; Jin Caizhi, Huaiyuan Army commander, was given Imperial Armory credentials; Gao Fu, Anhuai Army commander, was made Palace Gate Attendant; Tan Yu, Sizhou commander, was made Palace Gate Proclamation Cadet; Sun Li, Haozhou commander, was made Right Guards Major General — rewarding border defense merit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Chu Yizheng of Gaoyou Army was promoted to Palace Gate Proclamation Cadet; Jin Caizhi of Huaiyuan Army was given Imperial Armory credentials; Gao Fu of Anhuai Army was made Palace Gate Attendant; Tan Yu of Sizhou was made Palace Gate Proclamation Cadet; and Sun Li of Haozhou was made Right Guards Major General, in reward for defending the frontier.

sentences.zh: 壬午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On renwu, Great White was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 詔饒州被兵，令免今年田租。

translations.literal: An edict [said that] Raozhou having suffered military disaster, this year's field rent was to be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered this year's field rent remitted for Raozhou, which had suffered from the fighting.

sentences.zh: 路鈐劉用調兵入靖州，知州康玉刼之，通判張起岩入殺玉，復靖州。

translations.literal: Route Commander Liu Yong transferred troops into Jingzhou; Prefect Kang Yu robbed him; Vice Prefect Zhang Qiyan entered and killed Yu, recovering Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Route Commander Liu Yong moved troops into Jingzhou, but Prefect Kang Yu seized them; Vice Prefect Zhang Qiyan entered, killed Yu, and recovered Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，拘內司局錢餉兵。

translations.literal: On guiwei, inner bureau funds were impounded to supply troops.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, funds from the inner bureau were seized to pay the troops.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，令權糴公田今年租，每石以錢十貫給佃主，十貫給種戶，其鎮江、常州、江陰被兵者勿糴。

translations.literal: On bingxu, compulsory purchase of this year's public-field rents was ordered — ten strings of cash per picul to tenant lords, ten strings to seed households; Zhenjiang, Changzhou, and Jiangyin, where there had been military disaster, were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the court ordered compulsory purchase of this year's public-field rents, paying ten strings of cash per picul to tenant lords and ten to seed households; Zhenjiang, Changzhou, and Jiangyin, which had suffered from fighting, were exempted.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，謫似道爲高州團練副使〔六〕，貶循州，籍其家。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Sidao was demoted to Deputy Military Training Commissioner of Gaozhou, exiled to Xunzhou, and his household property confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Jia Sidao was demoted to deputy military training commissioner of Gaozhou, exiled to Xunzhou, and his property confiscated.

sentences.zh: 糴浙西邸第、寺觀田米十之三。

translations.literal: One-tenth of the grain from Zhexi manor and temple lands was compulsorily purchased.
translations.idiomatic: The court compulsorily purchased one-tenth of the grain from manor and temple lands in western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 追復皮龍榮官。

translations.literal: Pi Longrong's office was posthumously restored.
translations.idiomatic: The court posthumously restored Pi Longrong to office.

sentences.zh: 監司、郡守避事不即到官者，令御史臺覺察以聞。

translations.literal: Supervisors and prefects who shirked duties and did not promptly take office were to be investigated by the Censorate and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors and prefects who evaded their duties and failed to take office promptly were to be investigated by the Censorate and reported to the throne.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，王爚子嗾京學生劉九臯等伏闕上書言：宜中擅權，黨似道，芘趙溍、潛說友，使門客子弟交通關節，其誤國將甚於似道。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Wang Huo's son incited Capital University students Liu Jiugao and others to kneel at the palace gate and submit a memorial saying: Yizhong monopolizes power, factions with Sidao, shelters Zhao Wen and Qian Shuoyou, and lets household clients and sons exchange favors at checkpoints — his harm to the state will exceed Sidao's.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Wang Huo's son incited Capital University students led by Liu Jiugao to kneel at the palace gate and submit a memorial accusing Chen Yizhong of monopolizing power, allying with Jia Sidao, sheltering Zhao Wen and Qian Shuoyou, and letting clients and relatives trade favors at checkpoints — saying his harm to the state would exceed Sidao's.

sentences.zh: 宜中去，遣使四輩召之，皆不至。

translations.literal: Yizhong left office; four envoys were sent to summon him, but none came.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yizhong left office; four envoys were sent to summon him back, but he did not come.

sentences.zh: 謝堂乞罷兩浙鎮撫司，不從。

translations.literal: Xie Tang requested abolishing the Two-Zhe Pacification Commission; [the request] was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Tang asked to abolish the Two-Zhe Pacification Commission, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 張世傑乞濟師，不報。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie requested reinforcements; no response.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie requested reinforcements, but received no answer.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，下劉九臯等臨安獄，罷王爚爲醴泉觀使。

translations.literal: On renchen, Liu Jiugao and others were imprisoned in Lin'an; Wang Huo was dismissed as Liquan Abbey superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Liu Jiugao and the others were thrown into Lin'an prison, and Wang Huo was dismissed as superintendent of Liquan Abbey.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以夏貴知揚州，朱煥知廬州。

translations.literal: On guisi, Xia Gui was made Yangzhou commander and Zhu Huan Luzhou commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Xia Gui was appointed commander of Yangzhou and Zhu Huan commander of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣使召宜中還朝。

translations.literal: On jiawu, an envoy was sent to summon Yizhong back to court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, an envoy was sent to summon Chen Yizhong back to court.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以陳文龍同簽書樞密院事兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Chen Wenlong was made concurrent Deputy Bureau Director with acting Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Chen Wenlong was appointed concurrent deputy bureau director and acting vice councilor.

sentences.zh: 通判婺州張鎮孫聞兵遁，罷其官。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhensun, Wuzhou vice prefect, fled on hearing of troops; his office was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhensun, vice prefect of Wuzhou, fled when he heard that troops were coming, and was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 貶胡玉連州、林鏜韶州，並除名。

translations.literal: Hu Yu was demoted to Lianzhou and Lin Cong to Shaozhou; both were removed from the registers.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Yu was sent to Lianzhou and Lin Cong to Shaozhou, and both were struck from the registers.

sentences.zh: 沿江招討大使汪立信卒。

translations.literal: Riverine Pacification Commissioner Wang Lixin died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lixin, riverine pacification commissioner, died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，削李珏兩官、貶潮州。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Li Jue was stripped of two ranks and demoted to Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Li Jue was demoted two ranks and exiled to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 以開慶兵禍，追罪史嵩之奪其諡。

translations.literal: On account of the Kaixi military disaster, Shi Songzhi was posthumously punished and his posthumous epithet revoked.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the military disaster at Kaixi, Shi Songzhi was posthumously condemned and his posthumous epithet revoked.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遣使召宜中還朝。

translations.literal: On wuxu, an envoy was sent to summon Yizhong back to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, an envoy was again sent to summon Chen Yizhong back to court.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥朔，總制毛獻忠將衢州兵入衛。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jihai new moon: Overall Commander Mao Xianzhong led Quzhou troops to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, Overall Commander Mao Xianzhong led Quzhou troops to the capital's defense.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，疏決臨安府罪人。

translations.literal: On xinchou, review and sentencing of Lin'an prefecture offenders.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, prisoners in Lin'an prefecture were reviewed and sentenced.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，右正言徐直方遁。

translations.literal: On renyin, Right Remonstrator Xu Zhifang fled.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Right Remonstrator Xu Zhifang absconded.

sentences.zh: 加夏貴樞密副使、兩淮宣撫大使，李芾湖南鎮撫大使。

translations.literal: Xia Gui was promoted to Deputy Bureau Director and Two Huai Pacification Commissioner; Li Fu was made Hunan Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Gui was promoted to deputy bureau director and Two Huai pacification commissioner; Li Fu was made Hunan pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 總制戴虎破大南砦，轉三官。

translations.literal: Overall Commander Dai Hu captured Great South Fort and was advanced three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Overall Commander Dai Hu took Great South Fort and was promoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 加張起岩太府寺丞、知靖州，劉用以下立功人各轉官有差。

translations.literal: Zhang Qiyan was promoted to Palace Storehouse assistant director and Jingzhou prefect; Liu Yong and others who had won merit were each advanced in rank by varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qiyan was promoted to assistant director of the Palace Storehouse and made prefect of Jingzhou; Liu Yong and other men who had distinguished themselves were each promoted by varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 大元兵駐巴陵縣黃沙。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops encamped at Huangsha, Baling County.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces encamped at Huangsha in Baling County.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，吳繼明復平江縣。

translations.literal: On yisi, Wu Jiming recovered Pingjiang County.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Wu Jiming retook Pingjiang County.

sentences.zh: 戊申，試太學上舍生。

translations.literal: On wushen, examination of Imperial University upper dormitory students.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, upper dormitory students of the Imperial University were examined.

sentences.zh: 己酉，拘閻貴妃集慶寺、賈貴妃演福寺田還安邊所。

translations.literal: On jiyou, lands of Consort Yan's Jiqing Temple and Consort Jia's Yanfu Temple were impounded and returned to the Border Pacification Office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, temple lands held by Consort Yan at Jiqing Temple and by Consort Jia at Yanfu Temple were seized and returned to the Border Pacification Office.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，劉師勇攻呂城，破之。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Liu Shiyong attacked Lücheng and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Liu Shiyong attacked Lücheng and took it.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，復《嘉定七司法》。

translations.literal: On guichou, the "Kaixi Seven-Year Laws" were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the court restored the Kaixi Seven-Year Laws.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣使召宜中還朝。

translations.literal: On dingsi, an envoy was sent to summon Yizhong back to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, an envoy was again sent to summon Chen Yizhong back to court.

sentences.zh: 加張世傑神龍衛四廂都指揮使，總都督府諸兵。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie was promoted to Dragon Spirit Guard four-corps commander-in-chief, overall commander of commissioner headquarters troops.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie was promoted to commander-in-chief of the four corps of the Dragon Spirit Guard, with overall command of troops at the commissioner headquarters.

sentences.zh: 戊午，加劉師勇和州防禦使。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Liu Shiyong was promoted to Hezhou defender.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Liu Shiyong was promoted to defender of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: Sparkling Deluder infringed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Mars infringed on the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 趙淇除大理少卿，王應麟封還錄黃，言昔內外以寶玉獻似道，淇兄弟爲甚，己未，遂罷之。

translations.literal: Zhao Qi was made Assistant Minister of Justice; Wang Yinglin sealed and returned the recorded yellow, saying that formerly inside and outside court presented treasures and jades to Sidao, and the Qi brothers did so especially; on jiwei [Qi] was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Qi was appointed assistant minister of justice, but Wang Yinglin returned the recorded memorial, saying that court and provinces had once presented treasures to Jia Sidao and that the Qi brothers had been especially eager to do so; on jiwei Zhao Qi was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以文天祥爲浙西、江東制置使兼知平江府。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Wen Tianxiang was made West Zhe and East River Commissioner with concurrent Pingjiang prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Wen Tianxiang was appointed commissioner for western Zhejiang and the eastern Yangtze, with concurrent duties as prefect of Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，揚州文武官轉兩官。

translations.literal: On yichou, Yangzhou civil and military officials were each advanced two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, civil and military officials in Yangzhou were each promoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 加吳繼明湖北招討使，朱旺諸將各轉三官。

translations.literal: Wu Jiming was promoted to Hubei Pacification Commissioner; Zhu Wang and other generals were each advanced three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jiming was made Hubei pacification commissioner, and Zhu Wang and other generals were each promoted three ranks.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，陳宜中授觀文殿大學士、醴泉觀使兼侍讀。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jisi: Chen Yizhong was granted Palace Academician, Liquan Abbey superintendent, and concurrent lecture attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi, Chen Yizhong was granted the title of palace academician, made superintendent of Liquan Abbey, and appointed concurrent lecture attendant.

sentences.zh: 左司諫陳景行請令講官坐講陪宿直，從之。

translations.literal: Left Secretariat Remonstrator Chen Jingxing requested that lecturers sit to lecture and accompany night duty; [the court] assented.
translations.idiomatic: Left Secretariat Remonstrator Chen Jingxing asked that lecturers be seated to lecture and share night duty at court; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，加田謹賢福州觀察使，楊邦憲利州觀察使，趣入衛。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Tian Jinxian was promoted to Fuzhou observation commissioner and Yang Bangxian to Lizhou observation commissioner; [they were] urged to enter the capital guard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Tian Jinxian was promoted to observation commissioner of Fuzhou and Yang Bangxian to observation commissioner of Lizhou, and both were urged to come defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 己卯，陳宜中乞任海防，不允。

translations.literal: On jimao, Chen Yizhong requested coastal defense duty; not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Chen Yizhong asked to take charge of coastal defense, but the court refused.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，有事於明堂，赦。

translations.literal: On xinsi, suburban ceremony at the Bright Hall; amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the court performed the suburban rite at the Bright Hall and proclaimed an amnesty.

sentences.zh: 李成大被執，不屈死，壬午，贈五官。

translations.literal: Li Chengda was captured, refused to submit, and died; on renwu he was posthumously granted five ranks of office.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chengda was captured, refused to yield, and was killed; on renwu he was posthumously granted five ranks of office.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命文天祥爲都督府參贊官，總三路兵。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Wen Tianxiang was ordered made commissioner staff advisor, overall commander of three-circuit troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wen Tianxiang was appointed staff advisor to the commissioner headquarters, with overall command of troops on three circuits.

sentences.zh: 會稽縣尉鄭虎臣部送似道之貶所，至漳州，殺之。

translations.literal: Kuaiji county sheriff Zheng Humen escorted Sidao to his place of exile; at Zhangzhou he killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Humen, sheriff of Kuaiji county, escorted Jia Sidao to his place of exile and killed him at Zhangzhou.

sentences.zh: 大元兵至泰州，知州孫虎臣自殺，庚寅，贈太尉。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops reached Taizhou; Prefect Sun Huchen killed himself; on gengyin he was posthumously granted Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces reached Taizhou, and Prefect Sun Huchen committed suicide; on gengyin he was posthumously made grand mentor.

sentences.zh: 免靖州今年田租。

translations.literal: This year's field rent for Jingzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou was exempted from this year's field rent.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，徙李珏梧州。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Li Jue was exiled to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Li Jue was banished to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，劉良貴再削兩官、貶信州。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Liu Lianggui was again stripped of two ranks and demoted to Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Liu Lianggui was demoted two more ranks and exiled to Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 張彥與大兵戰敗被執，以城降。

translations.literal: Zhang Yan fought the great army, was defeated and captured, and surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yan fought the main Yuan army, was defeated and captured, and surrendered his city.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己亥，加張世傑沿江招討使，劉師勇福州觀察使，總統出戍兵。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jihai: Zhang Shijie was promoted to Riverine Pacification Commissioner; Liu Shiyong to Fuzhou observation commissioner; overall commander of deployed troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jihai, Zhang Shijie was made riverine pacification commissioner, Liu Shiyong observation commissioner of Fuzhou, and overall commander of troops deployed on campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，宜中來。

translations.literal: On renyin, Yizhong came.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Chen Yizhong arrived.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，玉牒殿災。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Imperial Genealogy Hall burned.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the Imperial Genealogy Hall caught fire.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以夢炎爲左丞相，宜中爲右丞相，並兼樞密使、都督。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Mengyan was made left chief minister and Yizhong right chief minister, both concurrent Bureau Director and commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Liu Mengyan was made left chief minister and Chen Yizhong right chief minister, each also serving as bureau director and commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 城臨安。

translations.literal: Lin'an was walled.
translations.idiomatic: The defenses of Lin'an were strengthened.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以張世傑爲沿江制置副使兼知江陰軍兼浙西策應使。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Zhang Shijie was made Riverine Deputy Commissioner with concurrent Jiangyin command and West Zhe response commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Zhang Shijie was appointed deputy riverine commissioner, commander of Jiangyin, and response commissioner for western Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太白會填星。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Great White conjoined with Saturated Star.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Venus conjoined with Saturn.

sentences.zh: 戊午，領戶部財用常懋、中書舍人王應麟請立濟王后。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Revenue Director Chang Mao and Secretariat Drafter Wang Yinglin requested establishing an heir to Prince Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Revenue Director Chang Mao and Secretariat Drafter Wang Yinglin asked that an heir be established for Prince Ji.

sentences.zh: 贈夏椅直秘閣。

translations.literal: Xia Yi was posthumously granted Direct Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Yi was posthumously made a direct secretariat scholar.

sentences.zh: 徵紹興府處士陸應月爲史館編校文字。

translations.literal: The recluse Lu Yingyue of Shaoxing was summoned as History Institute collator of texts.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yingyue, a recluse of Shaoxing, was summoned to serve as collator at the History Institute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大元兵發建康，參政阿刺罕、四萬戶總管奧魯赤將右軍出四安鎮，趣獨松關，參政董文炳、範文虎將左軍出江入，江陰軍，丞相伯顏將中軍入常州。

translations.literal: On renxu, Great Yuan troops set out from Jiankang: Deputy Councilor Arughan and forty-thousand-household commander Aoluchi led the right wing out from Si'an town toward Dusong Pass; Deputy Councilor Dong Wenbing and Fan Wengu led the left wing out from the river into Jiangyin; Chancellor Bayan led the center wing into Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Yuan forces marched from Jiankang. Deputy Councilor Arughan and Commander Aoluchi of the forty-thousand-household command led the right wing from Si'an toward Dusong Pass; Deputy Councilor Dong Wenbing and Fan Wengu led the left wing from the river into Jiangyin; and Chancellor Bayan led the center wing into Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: Sparkling Deluder infringed the Encampment Wall formation.
translations.idiomatic: Mars infringed on the Encampment Wall asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，張全、尹玉、麻士龍援常州，士龍戰虞橋死，全奔五牧。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhang Quan, Yin Yu, and Ma Shilong reinforced Changzhou; Shilong died fighting at Yu Bridge; Quan fled to Wumu.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhang Quan, Yin Yu, and Ma Shilong went to relieve Changzhou; Ma Shilong was killed fighting at Yu Bridge, and Zhang Quan fled to Wumu.

sentences.zh: 朱煥至廬州，貴不內。

translations.literal: Zhu Huan reached Luzhou; Gui would not admit him.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Huan reached Luzhou, but Xia Gui would not let him enter.

sentences.zh: 煥歸，復以爲淮東制置副使。

translations.literal: Huan returned and was again made East Huai Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Huan returned and was again appointed deputy commissioner for eastern Huai.

sentences.zh: 陳合坐匿廖瑩中家資，奪執政恩數。

translations.literal: Chen He was punished for concealing Liao Yingzhong's household assets and lost chief minister perquisites.
translations.idiomatic: Chen He was punished for concealing Liao Yingzhong's household assets and stripped of his chief minister perquisites.

sentences.zh: 甲子，尹玉戰五牧，死之，張全不戰遁。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Yin Yu fought at Wumu and died; Zhang Quan fled without fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Yin Yu fought at Wumu and was killed, while Zhang Quan fled without engaging.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，趣趙溍、趙與可、鄭所募兵。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Zhao Wen, Zhao Yu Ke, and Zheng Suo were urged to recruit troops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Zhao Wen, Zhao Yu Ke, and Zheng Suo were ordered to hurry their recruitment of troops.

sentences.zh: 詔中外官有習兵略者，各以書來上。

translations.literal: An edict [said that] officials inside and outside court who knew military strategy were each to submit written proposals.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered officials throughout the realm who knew military strategy to submit written proposals.

sentences.zh: 是月，李世修以江陰降。

translations.literal: That month, Li Shixiu surrendered Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Li Shixiu handed Jiangyin over to the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯朔，銅關將貝寶、胡巖起攻溧水死，贈寶武翼郎，岩起朝奉郎。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, first day dingmao: Tongguan generals Bei Bao and Hu Yanqi attacked Lishui and died; Bao was posthumously granted Martial Wing Gentleman, Yanqi Court Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, dingmao, Tongguan generals Bei Bao and Hu Yanqi attacked Lishui and were killed; Bao was posthumously made a Martial Wing Gentleman and Yanqi a Court Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以陳文龍同知樞密院事兼權參知政事，黃鏞同簽書樞密院。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Chen Wenlong was made Associate Bureau Director with acting Vice Councilor, Huang Yong Associate Signing Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Chen Wenlong was appointed associate bureau director with acting vice councilor, and Huang Yong associate signing bureau director.

sentences.zh: 命諸制司各舉才堪將帥者十人，不限偏裨士卒，如不隸軍中者，許投匱自薦。

translations.literal: [The court] ordered each commissioner to recommend ten men fit for command, not limited to officers or soldiers; if not in the army, they were permitted to submit self-recommendations in the suggestion box.
translations.idiomatic: Each regional commissioner was ordered to recommend ten men fit for command, whether officers, soldiers, or civilians not in the army, who might submit self-recommendations in the suggestion box.

sentences.zh: 辛未，起居舍人曾唯辭官不允，去。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Attendance Drafter Zeng Wei resigned but was not permitted and left.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, attendance drafter Zeng Wei sought to resign; the court refused and he left anyway.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，贈尹玉濠州團練使、麻士龍高州刺史，免張全、朱華臨陳退師罪。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Yin Yu was posthumously made Huainan training commissioner and Ma Shilong Gaozhou prefect; Zhang Quan and Zhu Hua were pardoned for withdrawing before the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Yin Yu was posthumously made training commissioner of Huainan and Ma Shilong prefect of Gaozhou; Zhang Quan and Zhu Hua were pardoned for retreating before the enemy.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔被俘將士能率衆來歸者，以人數補官，能立功者予節鉞；

translations.literal: On dingchou, an edict [said that] captured officers and soldiers who could lead troops to return would be given office according to the number of men; those who could achieve merit would receive command seals;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, an edict promised that captured officers and soldiers who led troops back to the Song would be promoted according to their numbers, and those who achieved merit would receive command seals;

sentences.zh: 諸閫以下官，以所招人多寡行賞。

translations.literal: officials below the commissioners would be rewarded according to how many men they recruited.
translations.idiomatic: and officials below the commissioners would be rewarded according to how many men they recruited.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，大元兵破廣德軍。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Great Yuan troops captured Guangde Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Yuan forces captured Guangde Commandery.

sentences.zh: 己卯，破四安鎮，正將胡明等死之。

translations.literal: On jimao, [they] captured Si'an town; company commander Hu Ming and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, they captured Si'an town; company commander Hu Ming and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 召文天祥入衛。

translations.literal: Wen Tianxiang was summoned to enter the capital guard.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Tianxiang was summoned to the capital for its defense.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，曾唯削一官免。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Zeng Wei was demoted one rank and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Zeng Wei was demoted one rank and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 太白犯房。

translations.literal: Great White infringed on the House asterism.
translations.idiomatic: Venus infringed on the House asterism.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大元兵至隆興府，黃萬石棄撫州遁，轉運判官劉槃以隆興降。

translations.literal: On renwu, Great Yuan troops reached Longxing Prefecture; Huang Wanshi abandoned Fuzhou and fled; transport vice commissioner Liu Pan surrendered Longxing.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Yuan forces reached Longxing Prefecture; Huang Wanshi abandoned Fuzhou and fled, and transport vice commissioner Liu Pan surrendered Longxing.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大元兵破興化縣，知縣胡拱辰自殺。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Great Yuan troops captured Xinghua County; magistrate Hu Gongchen killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Yuan forces captured Xinghua County; magistrate Hu Gongchen committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 甲申，中書舍人王應麟辭免兼給事中，不允。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Secretariat Drafter Wang Yinglin resigned from concurrent Drafting Receiver; not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, secretariat drafter Wang Yinglin resigned his concurrent post as drafting receiver; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 大元兵至常州，招降不聽，攻二日，破之，屠其城。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops reached Changzhou; surrender was offered but not accepted; after two days of attack [they] captured it and slaughtered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces reached Changzhou; when the city refused to surrender, they attacked for two days, captured it, and slaughtered the population.

sentences.zh: 知州姚訔、通判陳炤、都統王安節皆死，劉師勇潰圍奔平江。

translations.literal: Prefect Yao Yi, vice prefect Chen Zhao, and commander Wang Anjie all died; Liu Shiyong broke out of encirclement and fled to Pingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Yao Yi, vice prefect Chen Zhao, and commander Wang Anjie were all killed; Liu Shiyong broke out of the encirclement and fled to Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，改宜興縣爲南興軍。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Yixing County was changed to Nanxing Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Yixing County was elevated to Nanxing Commandery.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎陳景行辭官不允，去。

translations.literal: Rites Vice Minister Chen Jingxing resigned but was not permitted and left.
translations.idiomatic: Rites vice minister Chen Jingxing sought to resign; the court refused and he left anyway.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，贈濟王太師、尚書令，進封鎮王，諡昭肅，令福王與芮擇後奉祀，賜田萬畝。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Prince Ji was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and Director of the Secretariat, advanced to Prince Zhen with posthumous title Zhaosu; Prince Fu's son Yourui was ordered to choose an heir to maintain the sacrifices, and ten thousand mu of land were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Prince Ji was posthumously made grand preceptor and director of the secretariat, advanced to Prince Zhen with the posthumous title Zhaosu; Prince Fu's son Zhao Yourui was ordered to choose an heir to maintain the sacrifices, and ten thousand mu of land were granted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，獨松關告急，趣文天祥入衛。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Dusong Pass reported emergency; Wen Tianxiang was urged to enter the capital guard.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Dusong Pass reported an emergency; Wen Tianxiang was urgently summoned to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，調民兵出守余杭、錢塘。

translations.literal: On wuzi, militia were mobilized to guard Yuhang and Qiantang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, militia were mobilized to defend Yuhang and Qiantang.

sentences.zh: 己丑，獨松關破，馮驥死之，張濡遁，鄰邑望風皆遁。

translations.literal: On jichou, Dusong Pass fell; Feng Ji died; Zhang Ru fled; neighboring counties fled at the mere rumor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Dusong Pass fell; Feng Ji was killed and Zhang Ru fled; neighboring counties fled at the mere rumor of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 通判平江府鄭疇遁，庚寅，通判王矩之、都統制王邦傑遣人迎降於常州。

translations.literal: Pingjiang vice prefect Zheng Chou fled; on gengyin, vice prefect Wang Juzhi and commander Wang Bangjie sent men to welcome surrender at Changzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Pingjiang vice prefect Zheng Chou fled; on gengyin, vice prefect Wang Juzhi and commander Wang Bangjie sent men to welcome the Yuan at Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，大元兵趨撫州，都統密佑逆戰於璧邪，兵敗，死之。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Great Yuan troops pressed Fuzhou; commander Mi You fought them at Bixie, was defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Yuan forces pressed Fuzhou; commander Mi You fought them at Bixie, was defeated, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以張世傑爲浙西制置副使兼知平江府。

translations.literal: On guisi, Zhang Shijie was made West Zhe Deputy Commissioner with concurrent Pingjiang prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Zhang Shijie was appointed deputy commissioner for western Zhejiang and prefect of Pingjiang.

sentences.zh: 甲午，權禮部尚書王應麟遁，黃萬石提兵走建昌軍。

translations.literal: On jiawu, acting Rites Minister Wang Yinglin fled; Huang Wanshi led troops away to Jianchang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, acting rites minister Wang Yinglin fled, and Huang Wanshi led troops away to Jianchang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 乙未，左丞相夢炎遁。

translations.literal: On yiwei, left chief minister Mengyan fled.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, left chief minister Liu Mengyan fled.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣使召夢炎還朝。

translations.literal: On bingshen, envoys were sent to summon Mengyan back to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, envoys were sent to summon Liu Mengyan back to court.

sentences.zh: 賜余杭、武康、長興縣民錢，並免今年田租。

translations.literal: Money was granted to the people of Yuhang, Wukang, and Changxing counties, and this year's land tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Money was granted to the people of Yuhang, Wukang, and Changxing, and this year's land tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 鄭疇降一官，罷通判。

translations.literal: Zheng Chou was demoted one rank and dismissed as vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Chou was demoted one rank and dismissed as vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 撫州施至道以城降。

translations.literal: Fuzhou's Shi Zhidao surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zhidao of Fuzhou surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉朔，詔許似道歸葬，以其祖田廬還之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day dingyou: an edict permitted Jia Sidao's burial and returned his ancestral fields and lodges.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, dingyou, an edict permitted Jia Sidao's burial and returned his ancestral fields and lodges.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復趙與可爲都督府參議官，放李珏自便。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Zhao Yu Ke was restored as staff officer of the commander-in-chief's office; Li Jue was released to his own discretion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Zhao Yu Ke was restored as staff officer of the commander-in-chief's office, and Li Jue was released to his own discretion.

sentences.zh: 己亥，贈王汝翼朝奉郎。

translations.literal: On jihai, Wang Ruyi was posthumously granted Court Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Wang Ruyi was posthumously made a court gentleman.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以吳堅簽書樞密院事，黃鏞兼權參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Wu Jian was made Signing Bureau Director; Huang Yong acting Vice Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Wu Jian was made signing bureau director and Huang Yong acting vice councilor.

sentences.zh: 遣柳嶽奉書詣大元軍中，稱盜殺廉尚書，乞班師修好。

translations.literal: Liu Yue was sent with a letter to the Great Yuan army, saying bandits had killed Vice Minister Lian and begging withdrawal and restoration of good relations.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yue was sent with a letter to the Yuan army, claiming that bandits had killed Vice Minister Lian and begging them to withdraw and restore good relations.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以陳文龍爲參知政事兼權知樞密院事，賜謝堂同進士出身，同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On guimao, Chen Wenlong was made Vice Councilor with acting Bureau Director; Xie Tang was granted jinshi status and made Associate Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Chen Wenlong was made vice councilor with acting bureau director; Xie Tang was granted jinshi status and made associate bureau director.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，贈姚訔龍圖閣待制，其父希得贈太師，陳炤直寶章閣，馮驥集英殿修撰。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Yao Yi was posthumously made Dragon Diagram Hall Attendant; his father Xide Grand Preceptor; Chen Zhao Direct Treasure Pavilion; Feng Ji Imperial Academy Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yao Yi was posthumously made an attendant at the Dragon Diagram Hall; his father Xide grand preceptor; Chen Zhao direct treasure pavilion scholar; Feng Ji imperial academy compiler.

sentences.zh: 嘉興府告急，給封樁庫錢爲兵備。

translations.literal: Jiaxing Prefecture reported emergency; sealed reserve treasury money was issued for military preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxing Prefecture reported an emergency; sealed reserve treasury funds were issued for military preparations.

sentences.zh: 命趙與侲戍縉雲縣。

translations.literal: [The court] ordered Zhao Yulin to garrison Jinyun County.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yulin was ordered to garrison Jinyun County.

sentences.zh: 復季可官，令如龍泉縣募兵。

translations.literal: Ji Ke's office was restored and he was ordered to recruit troops at Longquan County.
translations.idiomatic: Ji Ke's office was restored and he was ordered to recruit troops at Longquan County.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以陳景行爲浙東安撫副使，戍處州。

translations.literal: On yisi, Chen Jingxing was made East Zhe Pacification Deputy Commissioner and garrisoned Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Chen Jingxing was made deputy pacification commissioner for eastern Zhejiang and garrisoned Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 起方逢辰戍淳安縣。

translations.literal: Fang Fengchen was recalled to garrison Chun'an County.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Fengchen was recalled to garrison Chun'an County.

sentences.zh: 丙午，追封呂文德和義郡王。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Lü Wende was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Heyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Lü Wende was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Heyi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，出安邊封樁庫金付浙東諸郡爲兵備。

translations.literal: On dingwei, frontier reserve treasury gold was issued to eastern Zhe prefectures for military preparations.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, frontier reserve treasury gold was issued to the prefectures of eastern Zhejiang for military preparations.

sentences.zh: 大元兵入平江府。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops entered Pingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces entered Pingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 起吳君擢爲太府少卿，提點臨平民兵。

translations.literal: Wu Junzhuo was recalled as Vice Director of the Palace Treasury and overseer of Lin'an civilian militia.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Junzhuo was recalled as vice director of the palace treasury to oversee Lin'an civilian militia.

sentences.zh: 遣使召夢炎、應麟，皆不至。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to summon Mengyan and Yinglin; neither came.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were sent to summon Liu Mengyan and Wang Yinglin; neither came.

sentences.zh: 戊申，張世傑入衛，加檢校少保，降詔獎諭。

translations.literal: On wushen, Zhang Shijie entered the capital guard, was promoted acting Junior Guardian, and an edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhang Shijie came to defend the capital, was promoted acting junior guardian, and received an edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 王爚薨，輟視朝二日。

translations.literal: Wang Huo died; court audiences were suspended two days.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Huo died; court audiences were suspended for two days.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，括臨安府州縣馬。

translations.literal: On yiyou, horses of Lin'an prefecture and counties were requisitioned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, horses throughout Lin'an prefecture and its counties were requisitioned.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，柳嶽還。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Liu Yue returned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Liu Yue returned.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，遣宗正少卿陸秀夫、刑部尚書夏士林、兵部侍郎呂師孟使軍前。

translations.literal: On guichou, Imperial Clan Vice Director Lu Xiufu, Punishments Minister Xia Shilin, and War Vice Minister Lü Shimeng were sent to the army front.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, imperial clan vice director Lu Xiufu, minister of punishments Xia Shilin, and vice minister of war Lü Shimeng were sent to the Yuan camp.

sentences.zh: 詔呂文煥、趙孟桂通好。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Lü Wen Huan and Zhao Menggui to negotiate peace.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Lü Wen Huan and Zhao Menggui to negotiate peace.

sentences.zh: 己未，方興、丁廣、趙文禮兵皆敗歸。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the armies of Fang Xing, Ding Guang, and Zhao Wenli were all defeated and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, the armies of Fang Xing, Ding Guang, and Zhao Wenli were all defeated and retreated.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以柳嶽爲工部侍郎，洪雷震爲右正言，使燕祈請。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Liu Yue was made Works Vice Minister and Hong Leizhen Right Remonstrator, sent to Yan to plead.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Liu Yue was made vice minister of works and Hong Leizhen right remonstrator and sent to Yan to plead.

sentences.zh: 大元兵破大洪山，知隨州朱端履降。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops captured Great Hong Mountain; Suizhou prefect Zhu Duanlu surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces captured Great Hong Mountain; Suizhou prefect Zhu Duanlu surrendered.

sentences.zh: 權吏部尚書丁應奎、左侍郎徐宗仁遁。

translations.literal: Acting Personnel Minister Ding Yingkui and left vice minister Xu Zongren fled.
translations.idiomatic: Acting personnel minister Ding Yingkui and left vice minister Xu Zongren fled.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣使召夢炎，不至。

translations.literal: On guihai, envoys were sent to summon Mengyan; he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, envoys were sent to summon Liu Mengyan; he did not come.

sentences.zh: 德祐二年春正月丁卯朔，大元兵自元年十月圍潭州，湖南安撫兼知州李芾拒守三月，大小戰數十合，力盡將破，芾闔門死，郡人知衡州尹穀亦舉家自焚，帥司參議楊霆及幕屬陳億孫、顏應焱等皆從芾死。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, first day dingmao of the second year of Deyou: Great Yuan troops had besieged Tanzhou since the tenth month of the previous year; Hunan Pacification Commissioner and prefect Li Fei held out three months with dozens of battles large and small; when strength was exhausted and the city was about to fall, Fei died with his whole household; Yin Gu of Hengzhou also burned himself with his family; staff officer Yang Ting and staff members Chen Yisun, Yan Yingyan, and others all died with Fei.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring in the second year of Deyou, dingmao: Yuan forces had besieged Tanzhou since the tenth month of the previous year. Hunan pacification commissioner and prefect Li Fei held out for three months through dozens of battles; when strength was exhausted and the city was about to fall, Fei died with his whole household. Yin Gu of Hengzhou also burned himself with his family. Staff officer Yang Ting and staff members Chen Yisun, Yan Yingyan, and others all died with Fei.

sentences.zh: 守將吳繼明、劉孝忠以城降。

translations.literal: Garrison commanders Wu Jiming and Liu Xiaozhong surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison commanders Wu Jiming and Liu Xiaozhong surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 寶慶降，通判曾如驥死之。

translations.literal: Baoxing surrendered; vice prefect Zeng Ruqi died.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing surrendered; vice prefect Zeng Ruqi was killed.

sentences.zh: 陸秀夫等至大元軍中，求稱侄納幣，不從；

translations.literal: Lu Xiufu and others reached the Great Yuan army and asked to address [the emperor] as nephew and offer tribute; not accepted;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xiufu and the others reached the Yuan camp and asked to address the emperor as nephew and offer tribute; this was refused;

sentences.zh: 稱侄孫，不從。

translations.literal: they asked to address [him] as grandnephew; not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: they asked to address him as grandnephew; this too was refused.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，還。

translations.literal: On wuchen, [they] returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, they returned.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后命用臣禮。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager ordered use of the minister's rite.
translations.idiomatic: The grand empress dowager ordered that ministerial rites be used.

sentences.zh: 己巳，嘉興守劉漢傑以城降。

translations.literal: On jisi, Jiaxing defender Liu Hanjie surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Jiaxing defender Liu Hanjie surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 庚午，同簽書樞密院事黃鏞、參知政事陳文龍遁。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Associate Signing Bureau Director Huang Yong and Vice Councilor Chen Wenlong fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, associate signing bureau director Huang Yong and vice councilor Chen Wenlong fled.

sentences.zh: 以謝堂爲兩浙鎮撫大使，文天祥知臨安府，全永堅浙東撫諭使。

translations.literal: Xie Tang was made Two-Zhe Pacification Grand Commissioner; Wen Tianxiang Lin'an prefect; Quan Yongjian East Zhe Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Tang was made grand pacification commissioner for the two Zhes; Wen Tianxiang prefect of Lin'an; and Quan Yongjian pacification commissioner for eastern Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命吳堅爲左丞相兼樞密使，常楙參知政事。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Wu Jian was ordered left chief minister and Bureau Director; Chang Mao vice councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Wu Jian was made left chief minister and bureau director, and Chang Mao vice councilor.

sentences.zh: 日午，宣麻慈元殿，文班止六人。

translations.literal: At noon, edicts were proclaimed at Ciyuan Hall; only six men stood in the civil ranks.
translations.idiomatic: At noon, edicts were proclaimed at Ciyuan Hall; only six men stood in the civil ranks.

sentences.zh: 諸關兵盡潰。

translations.literal: Troops at all passes were utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Troops at all passes were utterly routed.

sentences.zh: 遣監察御史劉岊奉表稱臣，上大元皇帝尊號曰仁明神武皇帝，歲奉銀絹二十五萬，乞存境土以奉蒸嘗。

translations.literal: Supervising Censor Liu Jie was sent with a submission declaring vassalage, addressing the Great Yuan emperor with the honorific Benevolent, Illumined, Divine, and Martial Emperor, offering twenty-five thousand taels of silver and silk yearly, begging to preserve the realm to maintain the ancestral sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Liu Jie was sent with a submission declaring vassalage, addressing the Yuan emperor as Benevolent, Illumined, Divine, and Martial, offering twenty-five thousand taels of silver and silk yearly, and begging to preserve the realm to maintain the ancestral sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，左司諫陳孟虎、監察御史孔應得遁。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Left Remonstrator Chen Menghu and Supervising Censor Kong Yingde fled.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, left remonstrator Chen Menghu and supervising censor Kong Yingde fled.

sentences.zh: 熒惑犯木星。

translations.literal: Sparkling Deluder infringed on the Wood Star.
translations.idiomatic: Mars infringed on Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大元兵至瑞州，知州姚岩棄城去。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Great Yuan troops reached Ruizhou; prefect Yao Yan abandoned the city and left.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Yuan forces reached Ruizhou; prefect Yao Yan abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以賈余慶知臨安府。

translations.literal: On yihai, Jia Yuqing was made Lin'an prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Jia Yuqing was made prefect of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命吉王昰、信王昺出鎮。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Princes Ji Zhao and Xin Zhao were ordered to take up territorial commands.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Princes Ji Zhao and Xin Zhao were ordered to take up territorial commands.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以夏士林簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Xia Shilin was made Signing Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Xia Shilin was made signing bureau director.

sentences.zh: 己卯，加全永堅太尉。

translations.literal: On jimao, Quan Yongjian was promoted Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Quan Yongjian was promoted grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 參知政事常懋遁。

translations.literal: Vice Councilor Chang Mao fled.
translations.idiomatic: Vice councilor Chang Mao fled.

sentences.zh: 三學生誓死不去，特與放釋褐出身。

translations.literal: Three-College students swore not to leave and were specially granted release from student status and entry into office.
translations.idiomatic: Students of the Three Colleges swore not to leave and were specially granted release from student status and entry into office.

sentences.zh: 以楊亮節爲福州觀察使，提舉吉王府行事；

translations.literal: Yang Liangjie was made Fuzhou Observation Commissioner and overseer of Prince Ji's household affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Yang Liangjie was made observation commissioner of Fuzhou and overseer of Prince Ji's household affairs;

sentences.zh: 俞如珪爲環衛官、提舉信王府行事。

translations.literal: Yu Rugui Imperial Guard officer and overseer of Prince Xin's household affairs.
translations.idiomatic: and Yu Rugui imperial guard officer and overseer of Prince Xin's household affairs.

sentences.zh: 大元兵入安吉州，知州趙良淳自經死。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops entered Anji Prefecture; prefect Zhao Liangchun hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan forces entered Anji Prefecture; prefect Zhao Liangchun hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 月暈東井。

translations.literal: The moon was haloed at the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: A halo appeared around the moon at the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，簽書樞密院夏士林遁。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Signing Bureau Director Xia Shilin fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, signing bureau director Xia Shilin fled.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祀太乙宮。

translations.literal: On xinsi, the Grand Unity Palace was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, sacrifices were offered at the Grand Unity Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸未，升封吉王昰爲益王，判福州、福建安撫大使；

translations.literal: On guiwei, Prince Ji Zhao was advanced to Prince Yi and made prefect of Fuzhou and Fujian Pacification Grand Commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Prince Ji Zhao was advanced to Prince Yi and made prefect of Fuzhou and grand pacification commissioner of Fujian;

sentences.zh: 信王昺爲廣王，判泉州兼判南外宗正事。

translations.literal: Prince Xin Zhao was made Prince Guang and made prefect of Quanzhou with concurrent southern outer imperial clan director.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xin Zhao was made Prince Guang, prefect of Quanzhou, and concurrent director of the southern outer imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 以留夢炎爲江東西、湖南北宣撫大使。

translations.literal: Liu Mengyan was made East and West Jiang and Hunan Pacification Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mengyan was made grand pacification commissioner for the Jiangs and Hunan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大元兵至皋亭山，遣監察御史楊應奎上傳國璽降，其表曰：「宋國主臣㬎謹百拜奉表言，臣眇然幼沖，遭家多難，權奸似道背盟誤國，至勤興師問罪。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Great Yuan troops reached Gaoting Mountain; Supervising Censor Yang Yingkui was sent up with the dynastic seal to surrender; the memorial said: "The Song ruler and subject Xian humbly bows a hundred times and presents this memorial, saying: I am utterly young and in my minority, and my house has met many hardships; the powerful traitor Jia Sidao broke the alliance and ruined the state, until Your Majesty raised troops to question our crimes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Yuan forces reached Gaoting Mountain; supervising censor Yang Yingkui was sent with the dynastic seal to surrender. The memorial read: "The Song ruler and subject Zhao Xian humbly bows a hundred times and presents this memorial, saying: I am utterly young and in my minority, and my house has met many hardships; the powerful traitor Jia Sidao broke the alliance and ruined the state, until Your Majesty raised troops to question our crimes.

sentences.zh: 臣非不能遷避，以求苟全，今天命有歸，臣將焉往。

translations.literal: It is not that I could not move aside to seek mere survival, but now Heaven's mandate has a new home—whither should I go?
translations.idiomatic: It is not that I could not move aside to seek mere survival, but now Heaven's mandate has a new home—whither should I go?

sentences.zh: 謹奉太皇太后命，削去帝號，以兩浙、福建、江東西、湖南、二廣、兩淮、四川見存州郡，悉上聖朝，爲宗社生靈祈哀請命。

translations.literal: Respectfully following the Grand Empress Dowager's order, I remove the imperial title and offer all surviving prefectures of the two Zhes, Fujian, the Jiangs, Hunan, the two Guangs, the two Huais, and Sichuan to the holy dynasty, praying for mercy on behalf of the altars and the people.
translations.idiomatic: Respectfully following the grand empress dowager's order, I remove the imperial title and offer all surviving prefectures of the two Zhes, Fujian, the Jiangs, Hunan, the two Guangs, the two Huais, and Sichuan to the holy dynasty, praying for mercy on behalf of the altars and the people.

sentences.zh: 伏望聖慈垂念，不忍臣三百餘年宗社遽至隕絕，曲賜存全，則趙氏子孫，世世有賴，不敢弭忘。

translations.literal: I hope Your sagely compassion will consider and not let the Zhao clan's more than three hundred years of altars suddenly perish; if you graciously grant preservation, then the Zhao descendants will rely on you generation after generation and dare not forget.
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your sagely compassion will consider and not let the Zhao clan's more than three hundred years of altars suddenly perish; if you graciously grant preservation, then the Zhao descendants will rely on you generation after generation and dare not forget.

sentences.zh: 」是夜，丞相陳宜中遁，張世傑、蘇劉義、劉師勇各以所部兵去。

translations.literal: " That night, chief minister Chen Yizhong fled; Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, and Liu Shiyong each led their troops away.
translations.idiomatic: " That night, chief minister Chen Yizhong fled; Zhang Shijie, Su Liuyi, and Liu Shiyong each led their troops away.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以文天祥爲右丞相兼樞密使、都督。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Wen Tianxiang was made right chief minister, Bureau Director, and commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Wen Tianxiang was made right chief minister, bureau director, and commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命天祥同吳堅使大元軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Tianxiang was ordered to go with Wu Jian to the Great Yuan army.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Tianxiang was ordered to go with Wu Jian to the Yuan camp.

sentences.zh: 賜家鉉翁進士出身、簽書樞密院事，賈余慶同簽書樞密院事、知臨安府。

translations.literal: Jia Xuanweng was granted jinshi status and made Signing Bureau Director; Jia Yuqing Associate Signing Bureau Director and Lin'an prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Jia Xuanweng was granted jinshi status and made signing bureau director; Jia Yuqing associate signing bureau director and prefect of Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 戊子，知建德軍方回、知婺州劉怡、知處州梁椅、知台州楊必大皆降。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Jiande commander Fang Hui, Wuzhou prefect Liu Yi, Chuzhou prefect Liang Yi, and Taizhou prefect Yang Bidu all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Jiande commander Fang Hui, Wuzhou prefect Liu Yi, Chuzhou prefect Liang Yi, and Taizhou prefect Yang Bidu all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 是月，知臨江軍滕岩瞻遁。

translations.literal: That month, Linjiang commander Teng Yanzhan fled.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Linjiang commander Teng Yanzhan fled.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉朔，日中有黑子相蕩，如鵝卵。

translations.literal: Second month, first day dingyou: a black spot oscillated within the sun like a goose egg.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, dingyou, a black spot oscillated within the sun like a goose egg.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，率百官拜表祥曦殿，詔諭郡縣使降。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the hundred officials led a submission at Xiangxi Hall; an edict instructed prefectures and counties to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the hundred officials led a submission at Xiangxi Hall, and an edict instructed prefectures and counties to surrender.

sentences.zh: 大元使者入臨安府，封府庫，收史館、禮寺圖書及百司符印、告敕，罷官府及侍衛軍。

translations.literal: Great Yuan envoys entered Lin'an Prefecture, sealed the treasuries, collected History Institute, Rites Office books, and all ministry seals, patents, and commissions, and abolished government offices and the guard army.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan envoys entered Lin'an Prefecture, sealed the treasuries, collected books from the History Institute and Rites Office and all ministry seals, patents, and commissions, and abolished government offices and the guard army.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，猶遣賈余慶、吳堅、謝堂、劉岊、家鉉翁充祈請使。

translations.literal: On renyin, Jia Yuqing, Wu Jian, Xie Tang, Liu Jie, and Jia Xuanweng were still sent as pleading envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Jia Yuqing, Wu Jian, Xie Tang, Liu Jie, and Jia Xuanweng were still sent as pleading envoys.

sentences.zh: 是日，大元軍軍錢塘江沙上，潮三日不至。

translations.literal: That day, Great Yuan troops camped on the Qiantang River sands; the tide did not come for three days.
translations.idiomatic: That day, Yuan troops camped on the Qiantang River sands; the tide did not come for three days.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，入朝。

translations.literal: Third month dingchou, [the emperor] entered court.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingchou, the emperor entered court.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，朝於上都。

translations.literal: Fifth month bingshen, [he] had audience at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingshen, he had audience at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 降封開府儀同三司、瀛國公。

translations.literal: He was demoted and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying with the ceremony of opening office and equal thirds.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying with the ceremony of opening office and equal thirds.

sentences.zh: 是月，陳宜中等立昰于福州，後二年四月，昰殂於碙洲，陸秀夫等復立衛王昺，後三年始平之。

translations.literal: That month, Chen Yizhong and others established Zhao in Fuzhou; two years and four months later Zhao died at Yaozhou; Lu Xiufu and others again established Prince Wei Zhao; three years later [the remnant] was finally pacified.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Chen Yizhong and others established Zhao Zhao in Fuzhou; two years and four months later he died at Yaozhou; Lu Xiufu and others then established Prince Wei Zhao Bing; three years later the remnant was finally pacified.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：司馬遷論秦、趙世系同出伯益。

translations.literal: Appraisal: Sima Qian discussed how the Qin and Zhao lineages both descended from Bo Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: Sima Qian discussed how the Qin and Zhao lineages both descended from Bo Yi.

sentences.zh: 夫稷、契、伯益其子孫皆有天下，至於運祚短長，亦系其功德之厚薄焉。

translations.literal: The descendants of Hou Ji, Qi, and Bo Yi all possessed the realm; as for whether fortune was short or long, it also depended on the thickness of their merit.
translations.idiomatic: The descendants of Hou Ji, Qi, and Bo Yi all possessed the realm; whether fortune was short or long also depended on the thickness of their merit.

sentences.zh: 趙宋雖起于用武，功成治定之後，以仁傳家，視秦宜有間矣。

translations.literal: Although Zhao Song rose through martial force, after success was achieved and order settled they passed the realm down through benevolence; compared with Qin there should have been a difference.
translations.idiomatic: Although Zhao Song rose through martial force, after success was achieved and order settled they passed the realm down through benevolence; compared with Qin there should have been a difference.

sentences.zh: 然仁之敝失於弱，即文之敝失於僿也。

translations.literal: Yet the defect of benevolence lies in weakness, just as the defect of culture lies in pedantry.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the defect of benevolence lies in weakness, just as the defect of culture lies in pedantry.

sentences.zh: 中世有欲自強，以革其敝，用乖其方，馴致棼擾。

translations.literal: In the middle period some wished to strengthen themselves to reform these defects, but used methods contrary to the proper direction and gradually brought on disorder.
