translations.idiomatic: In the middle period some wished to strengthen themselves to reform these defects, but used methods contrary to the proper direction and gradually brought on disorder.

sentences.zh: 建炎而後，土宇分裂，猶能六主百五十年而後亡，豈非禮義足以維持君子之志，恩惠足以固結黎庶之心歟？

translations.literal: After the Jianyan era the realm was divided, yet they could still have six rulers for a hundred and fifty years before perishing—is it not that ritual and righteousness were enough to sustain the will of gentlemen, and favor and kindness enough to bind the hearts of the common people?
translations.idiomatic: After the Jianyan era the realm was divided, yet they could still have six rulers for a hundred and fifty years before perishing—is it not that ritual and righteousness were enough to sustain the will of gentlemen, and favor and kindness enough to bind the hearts of the common people?

sentences.zh: 瀛國四歲即位，而天兵渡江，六歲而群臣奉之入朝。

translations.literal: The Duke of Ying took the throne at four; when he was six the heavenly troops crossed the river, and at six the hundred officials presented him entering court.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Ying took the throne at four; when he was six the heavenly troops crossed the Yangtze, and at six the hundred officials presented him entering court.

sentences.zh: 漢劉向言：「孔子論《詩》至『殷士膚敏，裸將於京。

translations.literal: Han Liu Xiang said: "When Confucius discussed the Odes and reached 'The Yin warriors were sensitive and refined, naked they will go to the capital,'
translations.idiomatic: Han Liu Xiang said: "When Confucius discussed the Odes and reached 'The Yin warriors were sensitive and refined, naked they will go to the capital,'

sentences.zh: 』喟然歎曰：大哉天命，善不可不傳於後嗣，是以富貴無常。

translations.literal: he sighed and said: How great is Heaven's mandate! Goodness must be transmitted to later generations; thus wealth and honor are not constant.
translations.idiomatic: he sighed and said: How great is Heaven's mandate! Goodness must be transmitted to later generations; thus wealth and honor are not constant.

sentences.zh: 」至哉言乎！

translations.literal: How penetrating the words!
translations.idiomatic: How penetrating the words!

sentences.zh: 我皇元之平宋也，吳越之民，市不易肆。

translations.literal: When our great Yuan pacified Song, the people of Wu and Yue found the markets unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: When our great Yuan pacified Song, the people of Wu and Yue found the markets unchanged.

sentences.zh: 世祖皇帝命征南之帥，輒以宋祖戒曹彬勿殺之言訓之。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu ordered the commanders of the southern campaign always to be instructed with Song Taizu's admonition to Cao Bin not to kill.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu ordered the commanders of the southern campaign always to be instructed with Song Taizu's admonition to Cao Bin not to kill.

sentences.zh: 《書》曰：「大哉王言，一哉王心。

translations.literal: The Documents says: "How great are the king's words, how unified the king's heart."
translations.idiomatic: The Documents says: "How great are the king's words, how unified the king's heart."

sentences.zh: 」我元一天下之本，其在於茲。

translations.literal: The foundation of our Yuan's possession of all under Heaven lies herein.
translations.idiomatic: The foundation of our Yuan's possession of all under Heaven lies herein.

sentences.zh: 二王 附

translations.literal: The Two Princes, appendix.
translations.idiomatic: The Two Princes, appendix.

sentences.zh: 二王者，度宗庶子也。

translations.literal: The two princes were sons by a concubine of Duzong.
translations.idiomatic: The two princes were sons by a concubine of Duzong.

sentences.zh: 長建國公昰，母淑妃楊氏；

translations.literal: The elder was Prince of Jianguo Zhao; his mother was Consort Yang;
translations.idiomatic: The elder was Prince of Jianguo Zhao; his mother was Consort Yang;

sentences.zh: 季永國公昺，母修容俞氏。

translations.literal: the younger was Prince of Yongguo Zhao; his mother was Lady Xiurong Yu.
translations.idiomatic: the younger was Prince of Yongguo Zhao; his mother was Lady Xiurong Yu.

sentences.zh: 度宗崩，謝太后召賈似道等入宮議所立，衆以爲昰長當立，似道主立嫡，乃立㬎而封昰爲吉王、昺信王。

translations.literal: When Duzong died, Empress Dowager Xie summoned Jia Sidao and others into the palace to discuss whom to establish; the multitude thought Zhao was eldest and should be established; Sidao advocated establishing the legitimate heir, so Xian was established while Zhao was enfeoffed Prince Ji and Zhao Prince Xin.
translations.idiomatic: When Duzong died, Empress Dowager Xie summoned Jia Sidao and others into the palace to discuss whom to establish; the multitude thought Zhao was eldest and should be established; Sidao advocated establishing the legitimate heir, so Xian was established while Zhao was enfeoffed Prince Ji and Bing Prince Xin.

sentences.zh: 德祐二年正月，文天祥尹臨安，請以二王鎮閩、廣，不從，始命二王出閣。

translations.literal: When Great Yuan troops pressed Lin'an, the imperial clan again petitioned; then Zhao was moved to Prince Yi, prefect of Fuzhou and Fujian Pacification Grand Commissioner, and Zhao to Prince Guang, prefect of Quanzhou with concurrent southern outer imperial clan director; the imperial son-in-law Yang Zhen and Yang Liangjie and Yu Rugui were made overseers.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan forces pressed Lin'an, the imperial clan again petitioned; then Zhao was moved to Prince Yi, prefect of Fuzhou and grand pacification commissioner of Fujian, and Bing to Prince Guang, prefect of Quanzhou with concurrent southern outer imperial clan director; the imperial son-in-law Yang Zhen and Yang Liangjie and Yu Rugui were made overseers.

sentences.zh: 大元兵迫臨安，宗親復以請，乃徙封昰爲益王、判福州、福建安撫大使，昺爲廣王、判泉州兼判南外宗正，以駙馬都尉楊鎮及楊亮節、俞如珪爲提舉。

translations.literal: When Great Yuan troops reached Gaoting Mountain, Zhen and others escorted the prince away to Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan forces reached Gaoting Mountain, Zhen and others escorted the prince away to Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 大元兵至皋亭山，鎮等奉之走婺州。

translations.literal: Chancellor Bayan entered Lin'an and sent Fan Wengu with troops toward Wu, summoning Zhen to return with the prince; Zhen received the report and left, saying: "I shall go die there to slow the pursuing troops."
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Bayan entered Lin'an and sent Fan Wengu with troops toward Wu, summoning Zhen to return with the prince; Zhen received the report and left, saying: "I shall go die there to slow the pursuing troops."

sentences.zh: 丞相伯顏入臨安，遣範文虎將兵趣婺，召鎮以王還，鎮得報即去，曰：「我將就死於彼，以緩追兵。

translations.literal: Liangjie and others then carried the prince on foot and hid in the mountains seven days; their general Zhang Quan with several dozen soldiers first caught up; they then fled together to Wenzhou; Lu Xiufu and Su Liuyi caught up on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Liangjie and others then carried the prince on foot and hid in the mountains seven days; their general Zhang Quan with several dozen soldiers first caught up; they then fled together to Wenzhou; Lu Xiufu and Su Liuyi caught up on the road.

sentences.zh: 」亮節等遂負王徒步匿山中七日，其將張全以兵數十人始追及之，遂同走溫州，陸秀夫、蘇劉義繼追及於道。

translations.literal: Men were sent to summon Chen Yizhong at Qing'ao; Yizhong came to pay respects; Zhang Shijie was again summoned at Dinghai; Shijie also came with his troops to Jiangxin Temple at Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Men were sent to summon Chen Yizhong at Qing'ao; Yizhong came to pay respects; Zhang Shijie was again summoned at Dinghai; Shijie also came with his troops to Jiangxin Temple at Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 遣人召陳宜中於清澳，宜中來謁，復召張世傑於定海，世傑亦以所部兵來溫之江心寺。

translations.literal: When Gaozong fled south he had once come here; there was an imperial seat in the temple; all together wept below the seat and acclaimed Zhao as commander-in-chief of all troops under Heaven, with Zhao as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong fled south he had once come here; there was an imperial seat in the temple; all together wept below the seat and acclaimed Zhao as commander-in-chief of all troops under Heaven, with Bing as deputy.

sentences.zh: 高宗南奔時嘗至是，有御座在寺中，衆相率哭座下，奉昰爲天下兵馬都元帥，昺副之。

translations.literal: They then raised troops and appointed officials; Prince Xiu Zhao Yourui was made Fujian Investigation Commissioner with pacification and western outer imperial clan director; Zhao Jifu southern outer imperial clan director with concurrent Fujian joint punishments commissioner; they entered Min first to pacify officials and people and instruct those of the same surname.
translations.idiomatic: They then raised troops and appointed officials; Prince Xiu Zhao Yourui was made Fujian investigation commissioner with pacification and western outer imperial clan director; Zhao Jifu southern outer imperial clan director with concurrent Fujian joint punishments commissioner; they entered Min first to pacify officials and people and instruct those of the same surname.

sentences.zh: 乃發兵除吏，以秀王與睪爲福建察訪使兼安撫、知西外宗正，趙吉甫知南外宗正兼福建同提刑，先入閩中撫吏民，諭同姓。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager soon sent two eunuchs with eight soldiers to summon the prince at Wen; Yizhong and others sank the soldiers in the river and then entered Min.
translations.idiomatic: The grand empress dowager soon sent two eunuchs with eight soldiers to summon the prince at Wenzhou; Yizhong and others sank the soldiers in the river and then entered Min.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后尋遣二宦者以兵八人召王于溫，宜中等沉其兵江中，遂入閩。

translations.literal: At that time Ting, Jian, and other prefectures were about to follow Huang Wanshi in surrender; hearing Zhao was coming, they immediately closed the cities and rejected envoys; Wanshi's generals Liu Jun, Song Zhang, Zhou Wenying, and others also mostly came over.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Ting, Jian, and other prefectures were about to follow Huang Wanshi in surrender; hearing Zhao was coming, they immediately closed the cities and rejected envoys; Wanshi's generals Liu Jun, Song Zhang, Zhou Wenying, and others also mostly came over.

sentences.zh: 時汀、建諸州方欲從黃萬石降，聞昰將至，即閉城卻使者，萬石將劉俊、宋彰、周文英輩亦多來歸。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day yiwei: Yizhong and others then established Zhao at Fuzhou as Song ruler, changed the era to Jingyan, enfeoffed Consort Yang as empress dowager with joint governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, yiwei, Yizhong and others established Zhao at Fuzhou as Song ruler, changed the era to Jingyan, and enfeoffed Consort Yang as empress dowager with joint governance.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未朔，宜中等乃立昰于福州，以爲宋主，改元景炎，冊楊淑妃爲太后，同聽政。

translations.literal: Prince Xin Zhao was enfeoffed Prince Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xin Zhao Bing was enfeoffed Prince Wei.

sentences.zh: 封信王昺爲衛王。

translations.literal: Yizhong was left chief minister and commander-in-chief; Li Tingzhi right chief minister; Chen Wenlong and Liu Fu vice councilors; Zhang Shijie deputy bureau director; Lu Xiufu signing bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhong was left chief minister and commander-in-chief; Li Tingzhi right chief minister; Chen Wenlong and Liu Fu vice councilors; Zhang Shijie deputy bureau director; Lu Xiufu signing bureau director.

sentences.zh: 宜中爲左丞相兼都督，李庭芝爲右丞相，陳文龍、劉黻爲參知政事，張世傑爲樞密副使，陸秀夫爲簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Wu Jun, Zhao Wen, Fu Zhuo, Li Jue, Zhai Guoxiu, and others were ordered to lead troops on separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jun, Zhao Wen, Fu Zhuo, Li Jue, Zhai Guoxiu, and others were ordered to lead troops on separate routes.

sentences.zh: 命吳浚、趙溍、傅卓、李珏、翟國秀等分道出兵。

translations.literal: Fuzhou was changed to Fu'an Prefecture; Wenzhou to Li'an Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou was changed to Fu'an Prefecture; Wenzhou to Li'an Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改福州爲福安府，溫州爲里安府。

translations.literal: Amnesty at the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Amnesty was proclaimed at the suburban sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 郊赦。

translations.literal: That day at dawn a great sound came from within the palace; all were startled and fell.
translations.idiomatic: That day at dawn a great sound came from within the palace; all were startled and fell prostrate.

sentences.zh: 是日黎明，有大聲出府中，衆皆驚僕。

translations.literal: Wen Tianxiang returned from escape at Zhenjiang; on gengchen he was made right chief minister and acting Bureau Director.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Tianxiang returned from escape at Zhenjiang; on gengchen he was made right chief minister and acting bureau director.

sentences.zh: 文天祥自鎮江亡歸，庚辰，以爲右丞相兼知樞密院事。

translations.literal: He sent his general Lü Wu into Jiang and Huai to recruit heroes; Du Hu went to Wenzhou to recruit troops.
translations.idiomatic: He sent his general Lü Wu into Jiang and Huai to recruit heroes; Du Hu went to Wenzhou to recruit troops.

sentences.zh: 遣其將呂武入江、淮招豪傑，杜滸如溫州募兵。

translations.literal: Guangdong Pacification Commissioner Xu Zhiliang sent Liang Xiongfei to request surrender at the Longxing commandery; [the court] then made Xiongfei acting pacification commissioner and sent him to subdue Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong pacification commissioner Xu Zhiliang sent Liang Xiongfei to request surrender at the Longxing commandery; the court then made Xiongfei acting pacification commissioner and sent him to subdue Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 廣東經略使徐直諒遣梁雄飛請降于隆興帥府，乃假雄飛招討使，使徇廣州。

translations.literal: Soon after Zhiliang heard Zhao was established and ordered acting vice prefect Li Xingdao and vanguard general Huang Jun and others to resist Xiongfei at Shimen; Xingdao would not fight; Jun was defeated and fled to Guangzhou; Zhiliang abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after Zhiliang heard Zhao was established and ordered acting vice prefect Li Xingdao and vanguard general Huang Jun and others to resist Xiongfei at Shimen; Xingdao would not fight; Jun was defeated and fled to Guangzhou; Zhiliang abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 既而直諒聞昰立，命權通判李性道、摧鋒軍將黃俊等拒雄飛于石門，性道不戰，俊戰敗奔廣州，直諒棄城遁。

translations.literal: Sixth month bingzi, Xiongfei entered Guangzhou; all surrendering generals were given office; only Jun would not accept and was killed by the crowd.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the sixth month, Xiongfei entered Guangzhou; all surrendering generals were given office; only Jun would not accept and was killed by the crowd.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子，雄飛入廣州，諸降將皆授以官，俊獨不受，遂爲衆所殺。

translations.literal: Wu Jun gathered troops at Guangchang and took Nanfeng, Yihuang, and Ningdu counties.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jun gathered troops at Guangchang and took Nanfeng, Yihuang, and Ningdu counties.

sentences.zh: 吳浚聚兵於廣昌，取南豐、宜黃、寧都三縣。

translations.literal: Zhai Guoxiu took Xiushan; Fu Zhuo reached Qu and Xin counties; many people responded.
translations.idiomatic: Zhai Guoxiu took Xiushan; Fu Zhuo reached Qu and Xin counties; many people responded.

sentences.zh: 翟國秀取秀山，傅卓至衢、信諸縣，民多應之者。

translations.literal: Wen Tianxiang was ordered Co-Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Tianxiang was ordered co-commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 命文天祥爲同都督。

translations.literal: Seventh month dingyou, [they] advanced to Nanjian Prefecture intending to take Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou of the seventh month, they advanced to Nanjian Prefecture intending to take Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，進兵南劍州，欲取江西。

translations.literal: That month, Wu Jun's army was defeated at Nanfeng; Guoxiu heard troops had come and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Wu Jun's army was defeated at Nanfeng; Guoxiu heard troops had come and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 是月，吳浚兵敗于南豐，翟國秀聞兵至，遂引還。

translations.literal: Fu Zhuo's army was defeated; he went to the Jiangxi Yuan commandery and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Zhuo's army was defeated; he went to the Jiangxi Yuan commandery and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 傅卓兵敗，詣江西元帥府降。

translations.literal: Council Director Ali Haiya broke Yan Pass; Ma Ji retreated to defend Jingjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Council director Ali Haiya broke Yan Pass; Ma Ji retreated to defend Jingjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 平章阿里海牙破嚴關，馬暨退保靜江府。

translations.literal: Eighth month, Zhangzhou rebelled; Chen Wenlong was made Min-Guang Pacification Commissioner to suppress it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Zhangzhou rebelled; Chen Wenlong was made Min-Guang pacification commissioner to suppress it.

sentences.zh: 八月，漳州亂，命陳文龍爲閩廣宣撫使以討之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Prince Xiu Yourui besieged Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Prince Xiu Yourui besieged Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，秀王與睪圍婺州。

translations.literal: On bingzi, hearing great troops had come, [they] broke off and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, hearing great troops had come, they broke off the siege and returned.

sentences.zh: 丙子，聞大兵至，遂解歸。

translations.literal: Wang Jinong was made Fujian Punishments Commissioner, Pacification and Recruitment Commissioner, and Nanjian prefect to defend the upper three prefectures;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jinong was made Fujian punishments commissioner, pacification and recruitment commissioner, and Nanjian prefect to defend the upper three prefectures;

sentences.zh: 以王積翁爲福建提刑、招捕使、知南劍州，備御上三郡；

translations.literal: Huang Quan joint punishments and pacification commissioner and Zhangzhou prefect to defend the lower three prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Quan joint punishments and pacification commissioner and Zhangzhou prefect to defend the lower three prefectures.

sentences.zh: 黃佺爲同提刑、招捕使、知漳州，備御下三郡。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie sent troops to help Wu Jun fight Marshal Li Heng at Douling; defeated, [they] fled to Ningdu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie sent troops to help Wu Jun fight Marshal Li Heng at Douling; defeated, they fled to Ningdu.

sentences.zh: 張世傑遣兵助吳浚與元帥李恒戰兜零，兵敗，奔寧都。

translations.literal: Xinghua stone-hand troops rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Xinghua stone-hand troops rebelled.

sentences.zh: 興化石手軍亂。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Chen Wenlong was again made Xinghua commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Chen Wenlong was again made commander of Xinghua.

sentences.zh: 九月，復以陳文龍知興化軍。

translations.literal: Dongguan man Xiong Fei held Chao and Hui for Huang Shijie; hearing Zhao Wen had come, he led troops to join him and attacked Xiongfei at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Dongguan man Xiong Fei held Chao and Hui for Huang Shijie; hearing Zhao Wen had come, he led troops to join him and attacked Xiongfei at Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 東莞人熊飛爲黃世傑守潮、惠二州，聞趙溍至，即以兵應之，攻雄飛于廣州。

translations.literal: On renyin, Xiongfei fled; Xiong Fei then recovered Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Xiongfei fled; Xiong Fei then recovered Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，雄飛遁，熊飛遂復韶州。

translations.literal: On renyin, Xiongfei fled; Xiong Fei then recovered Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Xiongfei fled; Xiong Fei then recovered Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 新會令曾逢龍亦帥兵至廣州，李性道出迎謁，飛與逢龍執而殺之。

translations.literal: Xinhui magistrate Zeng Fenglong also led troops to Guangzhou; Li Xingdao came out to welcome and pay respects; Fei and Fenglong seized and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Xinhui magistrate Zeng Fenglong also led troops to Guangzhou; Li Xingdao came out to welcome and pay respects; Fei and Fenglong seized and killed him.

sentences.zh: 衢州守將魏福興出戰福星橋，死。

translations.literal: Quzhou defender Wei Fuxing fought at Fuxing Bridge and died.
translations.idiomatic: Quzhou defender Wei Fuxing fought at Fuxing Bridge and was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，趙溍入廣州。

translations.literal: On renzi, Zhao Wen entered Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Zhao Wen entered Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，招討也的迷失會東省兵于福州。

translations.literal: That month, Pacification Commissioner Yede Shijie joined eastern province troops at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, pacification commissioner Yede Shijie joined eastern province troops at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 元帥呂師夔、張榮實將兵入梅嶺。

translations.literal: Marshals Lü Shiqian and Zhang Rongshi led troops into Meiling.
translations.idiomatic: Marshals Lü Shiqian and Zhang Rongshi led troops into Meiling.

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌朔，文天祥入汀州。

translations.literal: Tenth month, first day renxu: Wen Tianxiang entered Tingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month, renxu, Wen Tianxiang entered Tingzhou.

sentences.zh: 趙溍遣曾逢龍就熊飛禦大軍于南雄，逢龍戰死，熊飛奔韶州。

translations.literal: Zhao Wen sent Zeng Fenglong with Xiong Fei to resist the great army at Nanxiong; Fenglong died in battle; Xiong Fei fled to Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Wen sent Zeng Fenglong with Xiong Fei to resist the great army at Nanxiong; Fenglong died in battle; Xiong Fei fled to Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 大軍圍韶州，守將劉自立以城降，飛率兵巷戰，兵敗，赴水死。

translations.literal: The great army besieged Shaozhou; defender Liu Zili surrendered the city; Fei led troops in street fighting, was defeated, and drowned himself.
translations.idiomatic: The great army besieged Shaozhou; defender Liu Zili surrendered the city; Fei led troops in street fighting, was defeated, and drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 十有一月，參政阿刺罕、董文炳將兵至處州，李珏以城降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Deputy Councilor Arughan and Dong Wenbing led troops to Chuzhou; Li Jue surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, deputy councilor Arughan and Dong Wenbing led troops to Chuzhou; Li Jue surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，秀王與睪逆戰於里安，觀察使李世達死之。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Prince Xiu Yourui fought at Li'an; Observation Commissioner Li Shida died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Prince Xiu Yourui fought at Li'an; observation commissioner Li Shida was killed.

sentences.zh: 與睪及其弟與慮、子孟備、監軍趙由𤩲、察訪使林溫被執，皆死。

translations.literal: Yourui and his brother Yulü, son Mengbei, overseer Zhao Youqi, and investigation commissioner Lin Wen were captured and all died.
translations.idiomatic: Yourui and his brother Yulü, son Mengbei, overseer Zhao Youqi, and investigation commissioner Lin Wen were captured and all were killed.

sentences.zh: 阿刺罕兵至建寧府，執守臣趙崇釠，知邵武軍趙時賞、知南劍州王積翁皆棄城去。

translations.literal: Arughan's troops reached Jianning Prefecture; defender Zhao Chongjiao was captured; Shaowu commander Zhao Shishang and Nanjian prefect Wang Jinong all abandoned their cities.
translations.idiomatic: Arughan's troops reached Jianning Prefecture; defender Zhao Chongjiao was captured; Shaowu commander Zhao Shishang and Nanjian prefect Wang Jinong all abandoned their cities.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，昰入海。

translations.literal: On yisi, Zhao went to sea.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhao went to sea.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大軍至福安府，知府王剛中以城降。

translations.literal: On guichou, the great army reached Fu'an Prefecture; prefect Wang Gangzhong surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the great army reached Fu'an Prefecture; prefect Wang Gangzhong surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 昰欲入泉州，招撫蒲壽庚有異志。

translations.literal: Zhao wished to enter Quanzhou; pacification commissioner Pu Shougeng had other intentions.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao wished to enter Quanzhou; pacitation commissioner Pu Shougeng had other intentions.

sentences.zh: 初，壽庚提舉泉州舶司，擅蕃舶利者三十年。

translations.literal: Initially Shougeng had been maritime trade commissioner at Quanzhou and monopolized foreign-ship profits for thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Shougeng had been maritime trade commissioner at Quanzhou and monopolized foreign-ship profits for thirty years.

sentences.zh: 昰舟至泉，壽庚來謁，請駐蹕，張世傑不可。

translations.literal: When Zhao's boat reached Quan, Shougeng came to pay respects and asked him to halt; Zhang Shijie would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao's boat reached Quanzhou, Shougeng came to pay respects and asked him to halt; Zhang Shijie would not permit it.

sentences.zh: 或勸世傑留壽庚，則凡海舶不令自隨，世傑不從，縱之歸。

translations.literal: Some urged Shijie to detain Shougeng so that all sea vessels would not follow on their own; Shijie did not follow and let him return.
translations.idiomatic: Some urged Shijie to detain Shougeng so that all sea vessels would not follow on their own; Shijie did not follow and let him return.

sentences.zh: 繼而舟不足，乃掠其舟並沒其貲，壽庚乃怒殺諸宗室及士大夫與淮兵之在泉者。

translations.literal: Later when boats were insufficient, [they] seized his boats and also confiscated his goods; Shougeng then angrily killed all imperial clansmen, gentry, and Huai troops in Quan.
translations.idiomatic: Later when boats were insufficient, they seized his boats and also confiscated his goods; Shougeng then angrily killed all imperial clansmen, gentry, and Huai troops in Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 昰移潮州。

translations.literal: Zhao moved to Chaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao moved to Chaozhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，福、興化皆降。

translations.literal: That month, Fu and Xinghua both surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fu'an and Xinghua both surrendered.

sentences.zh: 英德守臣淩彌堅、徐夢得等亦降。

translations.literal: Yingde defenders Ling Mijian, Xu Mengde, and others also surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Yingde defenders Ling Mijian, Xu Mengde, and others also surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉朔，趙溍棄廣州遁。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, first day xinyou: Zhao Wen abandoned Guangzhou and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the twelfth month, xinyou, Zhao Wen abandoned Guangzhou and fled.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，制置方興亦遁，吳浚退走入瑞金。

translations.literal: On yichou, Commissioner Fang Xing also fled; Wu Jun retreated into Ruijin.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, commissioner Fang Xing also fled; Wu Jun retreated into Ruijin.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，蒲壽庚及知泉州田真子以城降。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Pu Shougeng and Quanzhou prefect Tian Zhenzi surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Pu Shougeng and Quanzhou prefect Tian Zhenzi surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 知興化軍陳文龍嬰城不下，乙酉，通判曹澄孫以城降，文龍被執，不屈死。

translations.literal: Xinghua commander Chen Wenlong held the city and would not come down; on yiyou, vice prefect Cao Chengsun surrendered the city; Wenlong was captured and died unyielding.
translations.idiomatic: Xinghua commander Chen Wenlong held the city and would not surrender; on yiyou, vice prefect Cao Chengsun surrendered the city; Wenlong was captured and died unyielding.

sentences.zh: 昰次甲子門。

translations.literal: Zhao stopped at Jiazi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao stopped at Jiazi Gate.

sentences.zh: 至元十四年正月，大軍破汀關。

translations.literal: First month of the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan, the great army broke Ting Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan, the great army broke Ting Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，知循州劉興降。

translations.literal: On guisi, Xunzhou prefect Liu Xing surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Xunzhou prefect Liu Xing surrendered.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，吳浚棄瑞金遁，鎮撫孔遵入瑞金，文天祥走漳州，浚尋還汀州，降。

translations.literal: On renyin, Wu Jun abandoned Ruijin and fled; pacification commissioner Kong Zun entered Ruijin; Wen Tianxiang fled to Zhangzhou; Jun soon returned to Tingzhou and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Wu Jun abandoned Ruijin and fled; pacification commissioner Kong Zun entered Ruijin; Wen Tianxiang fled to Zhangzhou; Jun soon returned to Tingzhou and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 戊申，知潮州馬發及其通判戚繼祖降，癸丑，復來歸。

translations.literal: On wushen, Chaozhou prefect Ma Fa and his vice prefect Qi Jizu surrendered; on guichou, [they] came back again.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Chaozhou prefect Ma Fa and his vice prefect Qi Jizu surrendered; on guichou, they came back again.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，權知梅州錢榮之以城降。

translations.literal: On dingsi, acting Meizhou prefect Qian Rongzhi surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, acting Meizhou prefect Qian Rongzhi surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 二月，大軍至廣州，縣人趙若岡以城降。

translations.literal: Second month, the great army reached Guangzhou; county man Zhao Ruogang surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the great army reached Guangzhou; county man Zhao Ruogang surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 廣東諸郡皆降。

translations.literal: All Guangdong prefectures surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: All Guangdong prefectures surrendered.

sentences.zh: 三月，文天祥取梅州，陳文龍從子瓚舉兵殺守將林華，據興化軍。

translations.literal: Third month, Wen Tianxiang took Meizhou; Chen Wenlong's nephew Zan raised troops, killed defender Lin Hua, and held Xinghua Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Wen Tianxiang took Meizhou; Chen Wenlong's nephew Zan raised troops, killed defender Lin Hua, and held Xinghua Commandery.

sentences.zh: 四月，文天祥取興國縣，廣東制置使張鎮孫襲廣州取之，梁雄飛等棄城走韶州。

translations.literal: Fourth month, Wen Tianxiang took Xingguo County; Guangdong Commissioner Zhang Zhensun attacked and took Guangzhou; Liang Xiongfei and others abandoned the city and fled to Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Wen Tianxiang took Xingguo County; Guangdong commissioner Zhang Zhensun attacked and took Guangzhou; Liang Xiongfei and others abandoned the city and fled to Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 五月，張世傑將兵取潮州，文天祥提兵自梅州出江西，入會昌縣，淮民張德興亦起兵殺太湖縣丞王德顒，據司空山，攻下黃州、壽昌軍。

translations.literal: Fifth month, Zhang Shijie led troops to take Chaozhou; Wen Tianxiang led troops from Meizhou into Jiangxi, entered Huichang County; Huai civilian Zhang Dexing also raised troops, killed Taihu county aide Wang Deyan, held Sikong Mountain, and captured Huangzhou and Shouchang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Zhang Shijie led troops to take Chaozhou; Wen Tianxiang led troops from Meizhou into Jiangxi and entered Huichang County; Huai civilian Zhang Dexing also raised troops, killed Taihu county aide Wang Deyan, held Sikong Mountain, and captured Huangzhou and Shouchang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遇宣慰鄭鼎，戰樊口，鼎墜水死。

translations.literal: On dingsi, [he] met Pacification Commissioner Zheng Ding; fought at Fan Pass; Ding fell into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, he met pacification commissioner Zheng Ding; they fought at Fan Pass; Ding fell into the water and drowned.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，文天祥取雩都。

translations.literal: Sixth month xinyou, Wen Tianxiang took Yudu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the sixth month, Wen Tianxiang took Yudu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，入興國縣。

translations.literal: On jimao, [he] entered Xingguo County.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, he entered Xingguo County.

sentences.zh: 七月，遣兵取吉、贛諸縣，圍贛州。

translations.literal: Seventh month, troops were sent to take Ji and Gan counties and besiege Ganzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, troops were sent to take Ji and Gan counties and besiege Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 衡山人趙璠、撫州人何時皆起兵應之。

translations.literal: Hengshan man Zhao Fan and Fuzhou man He Shi both raised troops in response.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fan of Hengshan and He Shi of Fuzhou both raised troops in response.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，張世傑圍泉州，遣將高日新復邵武。

translations.literal: On yisi, Zhang Shijie besieged Quanzhou and sent general Gao Rixin to recover Shaowu.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Zhang Shijie besieged Quanzhou and sent general Gao Rixin to recover Shaowu.

sentences.zh: 淮兵在福州者，欲殺王積翁以應世傑，皆爲積翁所戮。

translations.literal: Huai troops at Fuzhou wished to kill Wang Jinong to join Shijie; all were killed by Jinong.
translations.idiomatic: Huai troops at Fuzhou wished to kill Wang Jinong to join Shijie; all were killed by Jinong.

sentences.zh: 江西宣慰李恒遣兵援贛州，而自將兵入興國。

translations.literal: Jiangxi Pacification Commissioner Li Heng sent troops to relieve Ganzhou and himself led troops into Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi pacification commissioner Li Heng sent troops to relieve Ganzhou and himself led troops into Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 八月，文天祥諸將兵皆敗，乃引兵即鄒洬於永豐，洬兵亦潰。

translations.literal: Eighth month, all of Wen Tianxiang's generals' armies were defeated; he then led troops to join Zou Mian at Yongfeng; Mian's army also routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, all of Wen Tianxiang's generals' armies were defeated; he then led troops to join Zou Mian at Yongfeng; Mian's army also routed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，熒惑掩月，天色赤。

translations.literal: On jisi, Sparkling Deluder covered the moon; the sky's color was red.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Mars covered the moon; the sky turned red.

sentences.zh: 壬申，文天祥兵敗于興國。

translations.literal: On renshen, Wen Tianxiang's army was defeated at Xingguo.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Wen Tianxiang's army was defeated at Xingguo.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大軍破司空山，張德興敗，亡走。

translations.literal: On jimao, the great army broke Sikong Mountain; Zhang Dexing was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, the great army broke Sikong Mountain; Zhang Dexing was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 甲申，天祥至空坑，兵盡潰，遂挺身走循州，諸將皆被執。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Tianxiang reached Kongkeng; the army utterly routed; he then went alone to Xunzhou; all generals were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Tianxiang reached Kongkeng; the army utterly routed; he then went alone to Xunzhou; all generals were captured.

sentences.zh: 九月，元帥唆都援泉州。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Marshal Suodu relieved Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Marshal Suodu relieved Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊申，張世傑歸淺灣。

translations.literal: On wushen, Zhang Shijie returned to Qian Bay.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Zhang Shijie returned to Qian Bay.

sentences.zh: 左丞塔出將兵入大庾嶺，參政也的迷失將兵復取邵武，入福州。

translations.literal: Left Chancellor Tachu led troops into Dayu Ridge; Deputy Councilor Yede Shijie led troops to recover Shaowu and enter Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Left chancellor Tachu led troops into Dayu Ridge; deputy councilor Yede Shijie led troops to recover Shaowu and enter Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，唆都破興化軍，陳瓚死之。

translations.literal: Tenth month jiachen, Suodu broke Xinghua Commandery; Chen Zan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen of the tenth month, Suodu broke Xinghua Commandery; Chen Zan was killed.

sentences.zh: 進攻潮州，馬發拒之，乃去攻惠州。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Chaozhou, Ma Fa resisted; [he] then left to attack Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing to attack Chaozhou, Ma Fa resisted; he then left to attack Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月，塔出圍廣州。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, Tachu besieged Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Tachu besieged Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，張鎮孫以城降。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Zhang Zhensun surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Zhang Zhensun surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 元帥劉深以舟師攻昰於淺灣，昰走秀山。

translations.literal: Marshal Liu Shen with a fleet attacked Zhao at Qian Bay; Zhao fled to Xiushan.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Liu Shen with a fleet attacked Zhao at Qian Bay; Zhao fled to Xiushan.

sentences.zh: 陳宜中入占城，遂不反。

translations.literal: Chen Yizhong entered Champa and did not return.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Yizhong entered Champa and did not return.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，昰至井澳，颶風壞舟，幾溺死，遂成疾。

translations.literal: Twelfth month bingzi, Zhao reached Jing'ao; a typhoon wrecked the boats and he nearly drowned; he then fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi of the twelfth month, Zhao reached Jing'ao; a typhoon wrecked the boats and he nearly drowned; he then fell ill.

sentences.zh: 旬余，諸兵士始稍稍來集，死者十四。

translations.literal: After more than ten days the soldiers gradually gathered again; fourteen died.
translations.idiomatic: After more than ten days the soldiers gradually gathered again; fourteen had died.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，劉深追昰至七州洋，執俞如珪以歸。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Liu Shen pursued Zhao to Qizhou Ocean and captured Yu Rugui on his return.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Liu Shen pursued Zhao to Qizhou Ocean and captured Yu Rugui on his return.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月，大軍夷廣州城。

translations.literal: First month of the fifteenth year, the great army razed Guangzhou city.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year, the great army razed Guangzhou city.

sentences.zh: 張世傑遣兵攻雷州，不克。

translations.literal: Zhang Shijie sent troops to attack Leizhou but could not take it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shijie sent troops to attack Leizhou but could not take it.

sentences.zh: 己大軍克涪州，執守將王明。

translations.literal: On ji, the great army captured Fuzhou; defender Wang Ming was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On ji, the great army captured Fuzhou; defender Wang Ming was captured.

sentences.zh: 二月，大軍破潮州，馬發死之。

translations.literal: Second month, the great army broke Chaozhou; Ma Fa died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, the great army broke Chaozhou; Ma Fa was killed.

sentences.zh: 三月，文天祥取惠州，廣州都統淩震、轉運判官王道夫取廣州。

translations.literal: Third month, Wen Tianxiang took Huizhou; Guangzhou commander Ling Zhen and transport vice commissioner Wang Daofu took Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Wen Tianxiang took Huizhou; Guangzhou commander Ling Zhen and transport vice commissioner Wang Daofu took Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 昰欲往居占城不果，遂駐碙洲，遣兵取雷州。

translations.literal: Zhao wished to go live in Champa but could not; he then halted at Yaozhou and sent troops to take Leizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao wished to go live in Champa but could not; he then halted at Yaozhou and sent troops to take Leizhou.

sentences.zh: 曾淵子自雷州來，以爲參知政事，廣西宣諭使。

translations.literal: Zeng Yuanzi came from Leizhou and was made Vice Councilor and Guangxi Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Yuanzi came from Leizhou and was made vice councilor and Guangxi pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰，昰殂於碙洲，其臣號之曰端宗。

translations.literal: Fourth month wuchen, Zhao died at Yaozhou; his ministers gave him the temple title Duanzong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the fourth month, Zhao died at Yaozhou; his ministers gave him the temple title Duanzong.

sentences.zh: 庚午，衆又立衛王昺爲主，以陸秀夫爲左丞相。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the multitude again established Prince Wei Zhao as ruler; Lu Xiufu was made left chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the multitude again established Prince Wei Zhao Bing as ruler; Lu Xiufu was made left chief minister.

sentences.zh: 是月，有黃龍見海中。

translations.literal: That month, a yellow dragon was seen in the sea.
translations.idiomatic: That month, a yellow dragon was seen in the sea.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未朔，改元祥興。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day guiwei: the era was changed to Xiangxing.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fifth month, guiwei, the era was changed to Xiangxing.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，升碙洲爲翔龍縣。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Yaozhou was elevated to Xianglong County.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Yaozhou was elevated to Xianglong County.

sentences.zh: 遣張應科、王用取雷州，應科三戰皆不利，用因降。

translations.literal: Zhang Yingke and Wang Yong were sent to take Leizhou; Yingke fought three times without success; Yong then surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yingke and Wang Yong were sent to take Leizhou; Yingke fought three times without success; Yong then surrendered.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，應科再戰雷州，遂死之。

translations.literal: Sixth month dingsi, Yingke fought again at Leizhou and then died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi of the sixth month, Yingke fought again at Leizhou and was killed.

sentences.zh: 知高州李象祖降。

translations.literal: Gaozhou prefect Li Xiangzu surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozhou prefect Li Xiangzu surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己未，昺徙居崖山，升廣州爲翔龍府。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Zhao moved to dwell at Yashan; Guangzhou was elevated to Xianglong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Zhao moved to dwell at Yashan; Guangzhou was elevated to Xianglong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，有大星東南流，墜海中，小星千餘隨之，聲如雷，數刻乃已。

translations.literal: On jisi, a great star flowed southeast and fell into the sea; more than a thousand small stars followed; the sound was like thunder and lasted several quarters before stopping.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, a great star flowed southeast and fell into the sea; more than a thousand small stars followed; the sound was like thunder and lasted several quarters before stopping.

sentences.zh: 己卯，都元帥張弘范、李恒征崖山。

translations.literal: On jimao, Commander-in-Chief Zhang Hongfan and Li Heng campaigned against Yashan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, commander-in-chief Zhang Hongfan and Li Heng campaigned against Yashan.

sentences.zh: 十月，趙與珞與謝明、謝富守瓊州，阿里海牙遣馬成旺招之，與珞率兵拒于白沙口。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Zhao Yuluo and Xie Ming and Xie Fu defended Qiongzhou; Ali Haiya sent Ma Chengwang to summon them; Yuluo led troops to resist at Baisha Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Zhao Yuluo and Xie Ming and Xie Fu defended Qiongzhou; Ali Haiya sent Ma Chengwang to summon them; Yuluo led troops to resist at Baisha Mouth.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，州民執與珞以降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month guisi, prefectural people seized Yuluo and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the eleventh month, prefectural people seized Yuluo and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚戌，王道夫棄廣州遁。

translations.literal: Intercalary month gengxu, Wang Daofu abandoned Guangzhou and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu of the intercalary month, Wang Daofu abandoned Guangzhou and fled.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，淩震遁。

translations.literal: On renxu, Ling Zhen fled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Ling Zhen fled.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大軍入廣州。

translations.literal: On guihai, the great army entered Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the great army entered Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，王道夫攻廣州，兵敗被執。

translations.literal: Twelfth month renwu, Wang Daofu attacked Guangzhou; the army was defeated and he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu of the twelfth month, Wang Daofu attacked Guangzhou; the army was defeated and he was captured.

sentences.zh: 淩震兵繼至，亦敗。

translations.literal: Ling Zhen's troops came next and were also defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Ling Zhen's troops came next and were also defeated.

sentences.zh: 文天祥走海豐，壬寅，被執於五坡嶺。

translations.literal: Wen Tianxiang fled to Haifeng; on renyin, he was captured at Wupo Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Tianxiang fled to Haifeng; on renyin, he was captured at Wupo Ridge.

sentences.zh: 震兵又敗於芰塘。

translations.literal: Zhen's army was again defeated at Jitang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen's army was again defeated at Jitang.

sentences.zh: 大軍破南安縣，守將李梓發死之。

translations.literal: The great army broke Nan'an County; defender Li Zifa died.
translations.idiomatic: The great army broke Nan'an County; defender Li Zifa was killed.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月壬戌，張弘範兵至崖山。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year, first month renxu, Zhang Hongfan's troops reached Yashan.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu of the first month of the sixteenth year, Zhang Hongfan's troops reached Yashan.

sentences.zh: 庚午，李恒兵亦來會。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Li Heng's troops also came to join.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Li Heng's troops also came to join.

sentences.zh: 世傑以舟師碇海中，棋結巨艦千餘艘，中艫外舳，貫以大索，四周起樓棚如城堞，居昺其中。

translations.literal: Shijie anchored the fleet in the sea; more than a thousand great ships were linked, inner tower outer oar, pierced with great ropes; walls like ramparts were raised on all sides; Zhao dwelt in the center.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie anchored the fleet in the sea; more than a thousand great ships were linked, inner tower and outer oar, pierced with great ropes; walls like ramparts were raised on all sides; Zhao dwelt in the center.

sentences.zh: 大軍攻之，艦堅不動。

translations.literal: The great army attacked; the ships were firm and did not move.
translations.idiomatic: The great army attacked; the ships were firm and did not move.

sentences.zh: 又以舟載茅，沃以膏脂，乘風縱火焚之。

translations.literal: They also loaded boats with straw, soaked with grease, and rode the wind to set fire and burn them.
translations.idiomatic: They also loaded boats with straw, soaked with grease, and rode the wind to set fire and burn them.

sentences.zh: 艦皆塗泥，縛長木以拒火舟，火不能爇。

translations.literal: The ships were all coated with mud and bound with long timbers to repel fire boats; fire could not burn them.
translations.idiomatic: The ships were all coated with mud and bound with long timbers to repel fire boats; fire could not burn them.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅朔，世傑部將陳寶降。

translations.literal: Second month, first day wuyin: Shijie's subordinate Chen Bao surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, wuyin, Shijie's subordinate Chen Bao surrendered.

sentences.zh: 己卯，都統張達以夜襲大軍營，亡失甚衆。

translations.literal: On jimao, Commander Zhang Da made a night attack on the great army camp; losses were very heavy.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, commander Zhang Da made a night attack on the great army camp; losses were very heavy.

sentences.zh: 癸未，有黑氣出山西。

translations.literal: On guiwei, black vapor came out west of the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, black vapor came out west of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 李恒乘早潮退攻其北，世傑以淮兵殊死戰。

translations.literal: Li Heng took advantage of the early ebb to attack the north; Shijie with Huai troops fought to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Li Heng took advantage of the early ebb to attack the north; Shijie with Huai troops fought to the death.

sentences.zh: 至午潮上，張弘范攻其南，南北受敵，兵士皆疲不能戰。

translations.literal: By noon the tide rose; Zhang Hongfan attacked the south; attacked north and south, the soldiers were all weary and could not fight.
translations.idiomatic: By noon the tide rose; Zhang Hongfan attacked the south; attacked from north and south, the soldiers were all weary and could not fight.

sentences.zh: 俄有一舟檣旗僕，諸舟之檣旗遂皆僕。

translations.literal: Soon one boat's mast and pennant fell; then all the boats' masts and pennants fell.
translations.idiomatic: Soon one boat's mast and pennant fell; then all the boats' masts and pennants fell.

sentences.zh: 世傑知事去，乃抽精兵入中軍。

translations.literal: Shijie knew matters were lost and then drew elite troops into the center fleet.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie knew matters were lost and then drew elite troops into the center fleet.

sentences.zh: 諸軍潰，翟國秀及團練使劉俊等解甲降。

translations.literal: The armies routed; Zhai Guoxiu and training commissioner Liu Jun and others doffed armor and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The armies routed; Zhai Guoxiu and training commissioner Liu Jun and others doffed armor and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 大軍至中軍，會暮，且風雨，昏霧四塞，咫尺不相辨。

translations.literal: The great army reached the center fleet; it was dusk, and wind and rain came; mist filled all sides so that a foot apart could not be distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: The great army reached the center fleet; it was dusk, and wind and rain came; mist filled all sides so that a foot apart could not be distinguished.

sentences.zh: 世傑乃與蘇劉義斷維，以十餘舟奪港而去，陸秀夫走衛王舟，王舟大，且諸舟環結，度不得出走，乃負昺投海中，後宮及諸臣多從死者，七日，浮屍出於海十餘萬人。

translations.literal: Shijie then with Su Liuyi cut the ropes; with more than ten boats seized a harbor and left; Lu Xiufu went to Prince Wei's boat; the prince's boat was large and all boats were linked in a ring; estimating they could not break out, he then carried Zhao on his back and cast him into the sea; the harem and many ministers followed in death; seven days later more than a hundred thousand corpses floated out of the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Shijie then with Su Liuyi cut the ropes; with more than ten boats seized a harbor and left; Lu Xiufu went to Prince Wei's boat; the prince's boat was large and all boats were linked in a ring; estimating they could not break out, he then carried Zhao on his back and cast him into the sea; the harem and many ministers followed in death; seven days later more than a hundred thousand corpses floated out of the sea.

sentences.zh: 楊太后聞昺死，撫膺大慟曰：「我忍死艱關至此者，正爲趙氏一塊肉爾，今無望矣！

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Yang heard Zhao had died and beat her breast in great grief, saying: "I endured death and hardship to hold on until now only for this one piece of Zhao flesh—now there is no hope!"
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Yang heard Zhao had died and beat her breast in great grief, saying: "I endured death and hardship to hold on until now only for this one piece of Zhao flesh—now there is no hope!"

sentences.zh: 」遂赴海死，世傑葬之海濱，已而世傑亦自溺死。

translations.literal: " She then went into the sea and died; Shijie buried her on the seashore; soon after Shijie also drowned himself.
translations.idiomatic: " She then went into the sea and died; Shijie buried her on the seashore; soon after Shijie also drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 宋遂亡。

translations.literal: Song then perished.
translations.idiomatic: Song then perished.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：宋之亡徵，已非一日。

translations.literal: Appraisal: The signs of Song's perishing were not for a single day.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: The signs of Song's perishing were not for a single day.

sentences.zh: 歷數有歸，真主御世，而宋之遺臣，區區奉二王爲海上之謀，可謂不知天命也已。

translations.literal: When the sequence had a destination and the true lord ruled the age, yet Song's remnant ministers, in their narrowness, upheld the two princes for schemes on the sea—one may say they did not know Heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: When the sequence had a destination and the true lord ruled the age, yet Song's remnant ministers, in their narrowness, upheld the two princes for schemes on the sea—one may say they did not know Heaven's mandate.

sentences.zh: 然人臣忠於所事而至於斯，其亦可悲也夫！

translations.literal: Yet that as subjects they were loyal to what they served and came to this—how lamentable indeed!
translations.idiomatic: Yet that as subjects they were loyal to what they served and came to this—how lamentable indeed!
